Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the cited sections and the court's. The report has two parts. Part I measures the cost of the wrong text on 13 open-weight models. Reading the current text of amended law drops the Bar-standard score by 0.25 and missing repealed law drops it by 0.79. The penalty comes from rule changes, 0.45 on the 428 rule-changed items and none on the 331 wording-only items, and Citation F1 does not see it. The text in force is the fair setting. Part II benchmarks today's models on that setting. A public leaderboard ranks 26 models on a held-out test split of 500 items stratified by domain, with a validation split of the same shape released for public use, from memory alone, with the court's sections provided, and as a retrieval agent over the law in force, with the cost per item and the hallucinated citations. The best model scores 7.78 out of 10 and the best open-weight model 6.39. Without a search tool only five open-weight models recall any Thai law, and with it twenty of the 26 models gain and six lose. Leaderboard will take new models as they are released. Legal benchmarks must track dates, and on the right text today's models still leave a wide gap on Thai law.
items.title_ko: NitiBench+: 17개 도메인에 걸친 시계열 태국 법률 질문 답변 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: NitiBench+는 17개 도메인에 걸쳐 1,670개 항목으로 구성된 태국 법률 질문 답변 벤치마크로, 시간이 지남에 따라 법률이 변경되는 특성을 반영합니다. 결정 날짜 기준의 법률 텍스트와 현재 법률 텍스트를 모두 포함하여 법률 AI 모델의 시간적 추론 능력을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 법률 AI 시스템이 시간의 흐름에 따라 변화하는 법률 정보를 정확하게 처리하는 능력을 평가하는 중요한 벤치마크로, 법률 AI 모델의 실용성과 신뢰성 향상에 기여합니다.

items.title: VeriHarm-Bench: Measuring Harmful Success in LLM Coding Agents Verifiably
items.body: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly operate with shell access, allowing them to write scripts, move files, alter permissions, and modify system configurations. However, an agent may achieve a user's goal while causing unintended harm, such as deleting unrelated files, weakening access controls, or corrupting data, in response to benign inputs without explicit jailbreaking. This failure mode is particularly important because apparent task success may reassure users that an agent behaved correctly, causing harmful side effects to go unnoticed. We call this harmful success: the agent successfully completes the intended benign task while simultaneously causing unintended harm. Despite its importance, harmful success is difficult to measure because conventional task-success metrics overlook harmful behaviors, while existing safety evaluations are often designed solely to assess harmful outcomes. We introduce VeriHarm, an automatic framework for constructing programmatically verifiable benchmarks that directly measure harmful success. VeriHarm minimally perturbs coding tasks to elicit unintended harmful behavior while maintaining the benignity of the task and preserving the original task objective. It then synthesizes executable harm tests that, together with the original task-correctness tests, evaluate both task accuracy and harmful outcomes. Frontier agents, including GPT-5.6-Sol and Claude-Opus-5, achieve an average task accuracy of 95% on our curated VeriHarm-Bench, yet still struggle to complete tasks safely: their safe success rate, the fraction of tasks completed successfully without triggering the designated harm, averages only 37%. These results suggest that successful task completion can frequently coexist with unintended harm, and that task-success metrics alone may substantially understate the potential safety risks of coding agents.
items.body_ko: 대규모 언어 모델(LLM) 코딩 에이전트는 점점 더 셸 액세스를 통해 스크립트를 작성하고, 파일을 이동하고, 권한을 변경하고, 시스템 구성을 수정할 수 있게 됩니다. 그러나 에이전트는 명시적인 탈옥 없이도 무해한 입력에 대한 응답으로 관련 없는 파일을 삭제하거나, 접근 제어를 약화시키거나, 데이터를 손상시키는 등 의도하지 않은 해를 끼치면서 사용자의 목표를 달성할 수 있습니다. 이 실패 모드는 특히 중요합니다. 명백한 작업 성공이 사용자에게 에이전트가 올바르게 작동했다고 안심시킬 수 있고, 이로 인해 해로운 부작용이 간과될 수 있기 때문입니다. 우리는 이를 해로운 성공(harmful success)이라고 부릅니다. 에이전트가 의도된 무해한 작업을 성공적으로 완료하면서 동시에 의도하지 않은 해를 끼치는 경우입니다. 그 중요성에도 불구하고, 해로운 성공은 측정하기 어렵습니다. 기존의 작업 성공 지표는 해로운 행동을 간과하는 반면, 기존의 안전 평가 지표는 종종 해로운 결과만을 평가하도록 설계되었기 때문입니다. 우리는 해로운 성공을 직접 측정하는 프로그래밍 방식으로 검증 가능한 벤치마크를 구축하기 위한 자동화된 프레임워크인 VeriHarm을 소개합니다. VeriHarm은 작업의 무해성을 유지하고 원래의 작업 목표를 보존하면서 의도하지 않은 해로운 행동을 유발하기 위해 코딩 작업을 최소한으로 변경합니다. 그런 다음 원래의 작업 정확성 테스트와 함께 작업 정확도와 해로운 결과를 모두 평가하는 실행 가능한 해로움 테스트를 합성합니다. GPT-5.6-Sol 및 Claude-Opus-5를 포함한 최첨단 에이전트는 우리가 엄선한 VeriHarm-Bench에서 평균 95%의 작업 정확도를 달성했지만, 여전히 작업을 안전하게 완료하는 데 어려움을 겪습니다. 즉, 지정된 해를 유발하지 않고 작업을 성공적으로 완료한 비율인 안전 성공률은 평균 37%에 불과합니다. 이러한 결과는 작업 성공적인 완료가 의도하지 않은 해와 빈번하게 공존할 수 있으며, 작업 성공 지표만으로는 코딩 에이전트의 잠재적인 안전 위험을 상당히 과소평가할 수 있음을 시사합니다.
items.title_ko: VeriHarm-Bench: LLM 코딩 에이전트의 유해한 성공을 검증 가능하게 측정
items.summary_ko: VeriHarm-Bench는 셸 접근 권한이 있는 LLM 코딩 에이전트가 사용자 목표를 달성하면서 의도치 않은 해를 끼칠 수 있는 '유해한 성공(harmful success)'을 검증 가능하게 측정하는 벤치마크입니다. 파일 삭제, 접근 제어 약화 등 부작용을 탐지합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 코딩 에이전트의 안전성을 평가하는 데 있어 실질적인 위협 시나리오를 제시하며, 모델이 사용자 목표 달성뿐 아니라 잠재적 부작용까지 고려하도록 훈련하는 데 중요한 지표가 됩니다.

items.title: BISECT: Bilevel Spectral Decomposition for Low-Rank Continual Learning
items.body: Exemplar-free continual learning on pre-trained Vision Transformers increasingly relies on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), yet prevailing methods govern the low-rank update space through strict subspace isolation. By projecting each incoming task into the approximate null space of historical token activations, isolation-based learners equate any cross-task feature overlap with catastrophic interference. We show that this orthogonality premise induces a structural bottleneck we term \emph{spectral starvation}: when down-projection bases are locked before task optimization, the gradient norm reaching the trainable up-projection is upper-bounded by the energy of current-task features captured by the chosen basis. Because natural visual tasks share low- and mid-level covariance structure, historical null tails contain barely $5.5\%$ of incoming task variance, starving new-class plasticity while blocking positive consolidation along shared directions. We propose BISECT (Bilevel Spectral Decomposition), a continual LoRA framework that partitions a fixed rank-$r$ budget into two orthogonal functional blocks: an invariant carrier spanned by the dominant modes of the joint historical-and-current Gram matrix, and a novelty complement extracted via generalized Rayleigh whitening followed by orthogonal complement projection. After single-task training, BISECT folds both blocks back into the frozen backbone using a closed-form precision gate that scales each rank-1 invariant atom by its current-to-joint Rayleigh ratio while preserving novelty atoms at unit gain. Across eight incremental settings on ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, CIFAR-100, CUB-200, and DomainNet, BISECT outperforms prompt, adapter, and LoRA baselines with zero extra inference parameters or FLOPs, and remains complementary to sparse analytic expansion.
items.title_ko: BISECT: 저차원 지속 학습을 위한 이중 스펙트럼 분해
items.summary_ko: BISECT는 사전 훈련된 Vision Transformer에서 LoRA(Low-Rank Adaptation)를 사용한 지속 학습(continual learning)을 위한 이중 스펙트럼 분해(Bilevel Spectral Decomposition) 방법입니다. 기존 격리 기반 학습 방식의 구조적 병목 현상인 '스펙트럼 정체(spectral stasis)'를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 지속 학습 환경에서 AI 모델이 새로운 정보를 효율적으로 학습하면서 기존 지식을 잊지 않도록 하는 방법을 개선하여, 점진적인 AI 시스템 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: PlantVLM-Edge: Quantized Vision-Language Models for On-Device Crop Health Diagnosis
items.body: Timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is essential for sustainable agricultural production, yet accurate diagnosis often requires expert knowledge that is not readily available. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in visual understanding, reasoning, and natural-language interaction, creating new opportunities for intelligent crop health assessment. However, deploying VLMs on resource-constrained devices remains challenging due to their substantial computational and memory requirements. This paper presents PlantVLM-Edge, a quantized vision-language framework for conversational crop health diagnosis that can run entirely on resource-constrained edge devices. PlantVLM-Edge combines agricultural domain adaptation, post-training quantization, and on-device serving with an offline chat interface, allowing growers to ask open-ended questions and receive diagnoses, symptom explanations, and management guidance without cloud connectivity. The framework is backbone-agnostic: we validate it with two different VLM types with varying scale and architecture (Qwen3-VL-2B and LLaVA-1.5-7B), four quantization schemes, and two diagnostic domains (plant diseases and insect pests), and we deploy all variants on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Eight-bit quantization affects answer quality minimally relative to the full-precision model, and 4-bit activation-aware weight quantization (AWQ) retains 98.6% of full-precision answer quality on both domains while reducing the weight memory of the 2B backbone by 49%. In its most compact form, PlantVLM-Edge requires 2.01 GiB of weight memory, returns its first token in about 0.12 s, and completes a 64-token diagnostic response in 0.78 s. These results demonstrate that timely and accurate crop health diagnosis is practical on edge devices, providing a foundation for next-generation crop monitoring and decision support systems.
items.title_ko: PlantVLM-Edge: 온디바이스 작물 건강 진단을 위한 양자화된 Vision-Language 모델
items.summary_ko: PlantVLM-Edge는 자원 제약적인 온디바이스 환경에서 작물 건강 진단을 위해 양자화된 Vision-Language 모델(VLM)을 개발하는 연구입니다. 정확한 작물 건강 진단을 통해 지속 가능한 농업 생산에 기여합니다.
items.why_ko: 온디바이스 AI는 네트워크 연결 없이 실시간으로 작동할 수 있어 농업 현장에서 AI 기술의 접근성과 효율성을 높이는 데 핵심적인 역할을 합니다.

items.title: MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks: A Cross-Framework Measurement Study
items.body: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets agentic AI frameworks connect language models to external tool providers, but it carries attacker-controlled content (tool descriptions, schema fields, and response data) into model context without validation. Prior benchmarks measure model compliance with poisoned instructions without confirming real execution. We present the first cross-framework measurement of MCP tool poisoning with real tool execution. A 25-class root-cause taxonomy unifies prior classifications, and the open-source tool mcpvenom drives a 9,720-cell susceptibility matrix across 12 frameworks, 18 models, and 45 attack scenarios, with a dual oracle that confirms exfiltration via canary HTTP receipt. The overall attack success rate is 22.9% (2,113 vulnerable cells). Of these, 64.9% dispatch an attacker tool call, 23.0% contact the attacker endpoint, and 12.1% verifiably exfiltrate a secret. Resistance is model-level: nine core frameworks cluster within 23 to 26% (chi-squared = 3.30, p = 0.91), and no framework implements intentional defense. Incidental framework properties mitigate in specific cases, and a regex description scanner rejects 20 of 45 scenarios at a 7.2% false-positive rate, so metadata scanning alone is a partial control. Model ASR ranges from 0.4% to 49.7%. Claude Opus 4.8 is vulnerable in 8 of 530 cells while issuing 223 explicit refusals. A code-level audit finds no intentional defense across twelve frameworks, and all five coordinated disclosures across four vendors were rejected.
items.body_ko: MCP(Model Context Protocol)는 에이전트 기반 AI 프레임워크가 언어 모델을 외부 도구 공급자와 연결할 수 있도록 하지만, 유효성 검사 없이 공격자가 제어하는 콘텐츠(도구 설명, 스키마 필드 및 응답 데이터)를 모델 컨텍스트로 가져옵니다. 이전 벤치마크는 실제 실행을 확인하지 않고 오염된 지침에 대한 모델 준수 여부를 측정합니다. 우리는 실제 도구 실행을 통해 MCP 도구 오염을 측정한 최초의 교차 프레임워크를 제시합니다. 25개 클래스의 근본 원인 분류법은 이전 분류를 통합하며, 오픈 소스 도구 mcpvenom은 12개 프레임워크, 18개 모델, 45개 공격 시나리오에 걸쳐 9,720개 셀의 취약성 매트릭스를 구동하며, 카나리아 HTTP 수신을 통해 데이터 유출을 확인하는 이중 오라클을 사용합니다. 전체 공격 성공률은 22.9%(2,113개 취약 셀)입니다. 이 중 64.9%는 공격자 도구 호출을 디스패치하고, 23.0%는 공격자 엔드포인트에 연락하며, 12.1%는 비밀을 검증 가능한 방식으로 유출합니다. 저항은 모델 수준입니다. 9개의 핵심 프레임워크는 23%에서 26% 사이로 클러스터링되며(카이제곱 = 3.30, p = 0.91), 어떤 프레임워크도 의도적인 방어를 구현하지 않습니다. 우발적인 프레임워크 속성은 특정 경우에 완화되며, 정규식 설명 스캐너는 7.2%의 오탐률로 45개 시나리오 중 20개를 거부하므로 메타데이터 스캐닝만으로는 부분적인 제어에 불과합니다. 모델 ASR은 0.4%에서 49.7%까지 다양합니다. Claude Opus 4.8은 530개 셀 중 8개에서 취약하며 223개의 명시적인 거부를 발행합니다. 코드 수준 감사에서는 12개 프레임워크 전반에 걸쳐 의도적인 방어를 찾지 못했으며, 4개 공급업체에 걸친 5개의 조정된 공개는 모두 거부되었습니다.
items.title_ko: Agentic AI 프레임워크의 MCP 도구 오염: 교차 프레임워크 측정 연구
items.summary_ko: MCP(Model Context Protocol)를 사용하는 에이전트 AI 프레임워크에서 도구 설명, 스키마 필드, 응답 데이터 등 공격자 제어 콘텐츠가 모델 컨텍스트에 검증 없이 주입되어 '도구 오염'이 발생할 수 있음을 실험적으로 보여줍니다. 25가지 근본 원인 분류를 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 외부 도구와 상호작용할 때 발생하는 새로운 보안 취약점을 심층적으로 분석하여, 안전한 AI 에이전트 시스템을 설계하고 구현하는 데 필수적인 정보를 제공합니다.

items.title: Nonparametric Intensity Estimation for Covariate-Driven Poisson Processes Using Deep Learning
items.body: We consider nonparametric maximum likelihood estimation of the intensity function of a Poisson process, allowing the intensity to depend on observed covariates. Such models describe how event rates vary with external conditions, including conditions under which the intensity becomes arbitrarily small or vanishes. However, risk analysis based on the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence typically requires the true intensity to be bounded away from zero, a restrictive assumption in applications. We develop a unified approach that avoids this assumption and derive an oracle inequality for the covariate-averaged Hellinger distance between the true intensity and the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE). As an application of the oracle inequality, we establish convergence rates for NPMLEs based on deep neural networks (DNNs). Our results show that, as in nonparametric regression, the ability of DNNs to capture underlying structure leads to improved convergence rates. Specifically, DNN-based NPMLEs mitigate the curse of dimensionality when the true intensity has a compositional structure and automatically adapt to a low-dimensional Riemannian manifold structure of the event space. For intensity functions with a compositional structure, DNN-based NPMLEs achieve nearly minimax-optimal convergence rates without explicitly incorporating this structure into the network architecture. Simulations demonstrate that DNN-based estimators outperform kernel estimators in most settings, while manifold kernels remain competitive in some designs. Finally, we analyze stimulus-evoked neural spiking using data from the Allen Brain Observatory Visual Coding Neuropixels project. DNN-based NPMLEs provide better out-of-sample performance than a conditional kernel estimator, as evaluated by held-out log-likelihood.
items.title_ko: 딥러닝을 이용한 공변량 기반 푸아송 과정의 비모수적 강도 추정
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 관찰된 공변량에 따라 이벤트율이 변하는 푸아송 과정(Poisson process)의 강도 함수를 비모수적으로 추정하는 방법을 다룹니다. 특히, 강도가 0에 가까워지거나 사라질 수 있는 조건에서도 적용 가능한 딥러닝 기반 접근 방식을 개발합니다.
items.why_ko: 시계열 이벤트 데이터 분석 및 예측 분야에서 AI 모델의 정확성과 유연성을 향상시키는 방법론을 제시합니다.

items.title: Can LLM Agents Be Forward-Deployed Engineers? Requirement Discovery and Delivery for Enterprise Text-to-SQL
items.body: LLM coding agents can increasingly automate model post-training, but whether they can act as forward-deployed engineer (FDE) agents, discovering customer requirements and turning them into deployment decisions, remains unclear. We study this on a real enterprise text-to-SQL engagement: a simulated customer, grounded in the real use case's requirements, starts with an ambiguous request. An agent must discover acceptance criteria, data permissions, and hardware constraints in the discovery phase, then plan and execute a post-training recipe in the delivery phase. Across 15 models, the strongest discover over 80% of withheld requirements and open-weight models discover 40-50%; in the delivery phase, only 25% of runs across eight coding-agent configurations pass all acceptance criteria. We identify four bottlenecks in this engagement: (1) incomplete discovery, with 40% of withheld requirements missing or misrepresented; (2) unreliable execution; (3) underused compute budgets and a lack of systematic comparisons across base models and post-training methods; and (4) benchmark accuracy does not guarantee production readiness. We suggest human review of discovered requirements, monitoring of the agent's plan during execution, and an explicit experiment-environment specification covering hardware, budget scope, and production checks.
items.body_ko: LLM 코딩 에이전트가 모델 사후 학습을 점점 더 자동화할 수 있지만, 고객 요구 사항을 파악하고 이를 배포 결정으로 전환하는 선행 배치 엔지니어(FDE) 에이전트 역할을 할 수 있는지는 여전히 불분명합니다. 우리는 실제 기업의 텍스트-SQL 참여에서 이를 연구합니다. 실제 사용 사례의 요구 사항을 기반으로 시뮬레이션된 고객은 모호한 요청으로 시작합니다. 에이전트는 검색 단계에서 승인 기준, 데이터 권한 및 하드웨어 제약을 파악한 다음, 배포 단계에서 사후 학습 레시피를 계획하고 실행해야 합니다. 15개 모델에 걸쳐 가장 강력한 모델은 보류된 요구 사항의 80% 이상을 발견하고 오픈 소스 모델은 40-50%를 발견합니다. 배포 단계에서는 8개 코딩 에이전트 구성에 걸쳐 실행의 25%만이 모든 승인 기준을 통과합니다. 우리는 이 참여에서 4가지 병목 현상을 확인합니다. (1) 불완전한 검색, 보류된 요구 사항의 40%가 누락되거나 잘못 표현됨. (2) 신뢰할 수 없는 실행. (3) 컴퓨팅 예산 미사용 및 기본 모델과 사후 학습 방법 간의 체계적인 비교 부족. (4) 벤치마크 정확도가 생산 준비 상태를 보장하지 않음. 우리는 검색된 요구 사항에 대한 사람의 검토, 실행 중 에이전트 계획 모니터링, 하드웨어, 예산 범위 및 생산 점검을 포함하는 명시적인 실험 환경 사양을 제안합니다.
items.title_ko: LLM 에이전트가 현장 엔지니어가 될 수 있을까? 기업용 텍스트-SQL을 위한 요구사항 발견 및 전달
items.summary_ko: LLM 코딩 에이전트가 고객 요구사항을 발견하고 배포 결정으로 전환하는 '현장 엔지니어(forward-deployed engineer)' 역할을 수행할 수 있는지 연구합니다. 모의 고객 시나리오에서 에이전트가 수락 기준, 데이터 권한, 하드웨어 제약 조건 등을 발견하는 과정을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 복잡한 기업 환경에서 실제 비즈니스 요구사항을 이해하고 솔루션을 제공하는 엔드투엔드 개발 프로세스를 자동화하는 데 기여할 수 있는 잠재력을 보여줍니다.

items.title: Can LLM Agents Improve Imperfect Earth System Model Parameterizations?
items.body: Earth system models (ESMs) rely on parameterizations to represent unresolved processes such as convection, cloud microphysics, and turbulence. However, translating advances in physical understanding into stable, validated parameterizations and integrating them into ESMs often takes years. Agentic AI could accelerate this process and enable more systematic exploration of design choices. Using warm-rain collision-coalescence as a test case, we evaluate agents' ability to synthesize scientific literature, reimplement published bulk parameterizations, and propose new functional forms as differentiable JAX code. We compare conventional parameterizations, data-driven emulators, and agent-generated closures against high-fidelity superdroplet simulations, repeating unattended experiments across ten language models. With expert guidance or iterative feedback, agents produced executable, differentiable, mass-conserving code, although unattended performance depended strongly on the scheme and language model. Iterative feedback lowered median rollout error for eight of ten models. Retuned physical schemes matched or outperformed many learned parameterizations at substantially lower computational cost, but two of 100 unattended agent-generated closures achieved slightly lower rain-mass error than the most accurate retuned scheme on held-out simulations.
items.title_ko: LLM 에이전트가 불완전한 지구 시스템 모델 매개변수화를 개선할 수 있을까?
items.summary_ko: 지구 시스템 모델(ESM)의 불완전한 매개변수화를 LLM 에이전트가 개선할 수 있는지 연구합니다. 에이전트가 과학 문헌을 종합하고 설계 선택을 체계적으로 탐색하여 매개변수화 과정을 가속화할 가능성을 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 기후 변화 모델링과 같은 복잡한 과학 분야에서 AI 에이전트가 연구 과정을 가속화하고 모델 정확도를 높이는 데 기여할 수 있음을 시사합니다.

items.title: Variational Functional Neural Networks (vfNN)
items.body: We present a variational functional neural network (vfNN) algorithm that optimizes physically motivated continuum functionals in integral form (e.g., Lagrangian, Hamiltonian, or free energy) to find the states of a system. That way, vfNN bypasses solving the equations of motion (a.k.a. the Euler-Lagrange equations), which are in the form of differential equations. To this end, our approach is fundamentally different from conventional physics-informed neural networks (PINN) that solve differential equations by minimizing a phenomenological loss function involving higher order derivatives and ad hoc weight factors. In contrast, vfNN merely evaluates lower order derivatives of the generating functional and replaces the weight factors with rigorous physical scales. This also fundamentally changes the loss landscape, and the desired solutions may become unstable. For this emergent nonconvex optimization problem, we develop a quasi-Newton optimization algorithm with simulated annealing that converges to the solutions of the corresponding Euler-Lagrange equations of the functional regardless of their stability properties. Our simulations using vfNN give accurate results for benchmark systems governed by linear or nonlinear ordinary differential equations.
items.title_ko: 변분 함수형 신경망 (vfNN): 물리적 연속체 범함수 최적화
items.summary_ko: vfNN(Variational Functional Neural Network)은 물리적으로 동기 부여된 연속체 범함수를 최적화하여 시스템 상태를 찾는 알고리즘입니다. 이는 미분 방정식 형태의 운동 방정식을 직접 푸는 기존 PINN(Physics-Informed Neural Network)과 근본적으로 다릅니다.
items.why_ko: 물리 시스템 모델링에서 미분 방정식 풀이 없이도 시스템 상태를 예측할 수 있는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하여, 공학 및 과학 분야의 시뮬레이션 효율성을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: An Agentic Framework for Automated Power System Studies and Grid Connection Assessment
items.body: Connecting new generation and demand to the grid depends on two scarce skills: checking applications against a large, changing body of regulation, and running the network studies that decide where and how a project connects. We present Grid Agents, an AI system that brings both together, and the methodology we use to evaluate it. The Grid Ontology is its knowledge system. It represents the regulation, standards and engineering knowledge that grid work depends on, makes it searchable, and evolves as the agents learn from use. Every answer drawn from it rests on evidence the agents cite. Grid Studio is an agent system specialised for power-system engineering. It works in its own engineering environment with domain tools and a study framework, draws on the Grid Ontology, and relies on established solvers for every number it reports. In both, engineers make the decisions. We bring eight published power-system benchmark families, previously scattered across separate papers, into one suite of 519 tasks, and we verify not only each answer but the work behind it, by replaying the agent's tool calls. The Grid Ontology cites the right regulatory evidence more often than a general coding agent or retrieval pipelines, leads on LegalBench-RAG and ranks first on the public leaderboards of the Enterprise RAG Challenge and ViDoRe V3. Grid Studio scores highest on the 519 power-system tasks and is the fastest of all the systems we compare, both by a statistically significant margin. With an optimiser in the loop, its reinforcement packages cost 33-67% less on average than those the agent designs alone.
items.title_ko: 자동화된 전력 시스템 연구 및 계통 연계 평가를 위한 에이전트 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: Grid Agents는 새로운 발전 및 수요원을 계통에 연결하는 과정을 자동화하는 AI 시스템입니다. 이는 복잡하고 변화무쌍한 규제 준수 및 네트워크 연구를 통합하여 Grid Ontology 지식 시스템을 통해 관리합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 복잡한 인프라 관리 및 규제 준수 작업을 자동화하여 에너지 시스템의 효율성과 안정성을 향상시키는 데 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Contrastive Adapter Training and Consensus Knowledge Distillation for Multi-Source-Free Domain Adaptation in Skin Cancer Diagnosis
items.body: Skin cancer diagnosis, particularly differentiating melanoma from benign nevi, is challenging due to the visual similarity between lesions. Although convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and vision transformers (ViTs) have shown promising performance, their effectiveness often deteriorates on data from heterogeneous clinical sources. Conventional domain adaptation methods address domain shift but require access to source data during adaptation, which is often infeasible due to privacy regulations. Multi-source-free unsupervised domain adaptation (MSFDA) addresses this limitation by leveraging multiple labeled source domains to generalize to an unlabeled target domain without requiring access to source data. However, existing MSFDA methods rely on full backbone fine-tuning, leading to catastrophic forgetting and overfitting on small clinical datasets, and address domain shift at the aggregation stage without establishing a shared domain-invariant feature space. Furthermore, their reliance on hard pseudo-labels or confidence-weighted aggregation introduces noisy supervision signals under domain shift. To address these limitations, we propose CAT-CKD, consisting of two components: (1) contrastive adapter training (CAT), which trains lightweight ConvPass adapters within a frozen ViT backbone using supervised contrastive learning (SCL) to establish a shared domain-invariant feature space before source-specific model training, and (2) consensus knowledge distillation (CKD), which aggregates logits from multiple source models into a consensus supervisory signal and adapts a student model on unlabeled target data using KL divergence. Experiments on five publicly available skin lesion datasets show that CAT-CKD achieves an average AUROC of 86.1%, outperforming existing MSFDA methods while requiring only 4.3M trainable parameters. The code is available at https://github.com/A-Abedi/CAT_CKD.
items.title_ko: 피부암 진단에서 다중 소스 없는 도메인 적응을 위한 대조적 어댑터 훈련 및 합의 지식 증류
items.summary_ko: 피부암 진단에서 서로 다른 임상 소스 데이터 간의 도메인 시프트 문제를 해결하기 위해, 소스 데이터에 접근할 수 없는 상황에서 대조적 어댑터 훈련과 합의 지식 증류(Consensus Knowledge Distillation)를 사용하는 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 모델이 다양한 임상 환경에서도 높은 성능을 유지할 수 있도록 하는 도메인 적응 기술은 AI의 의료 적용 가능성을 확장하는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
items.body: Computer programmers chain together the same reusable computational primitives, for example, conditional statements or loops, but in different orders to implement different algorithms. In contrast, existing language model architectures always execute their layers in the same order. We introduce Library of Layers (LoL), an architecture that dynamically orders its layers during inference to solve the problem at hand. LoL has a single hyperparameter, the size of its global library of transformer blocks, that allows it to transition seamlessly between parameter reuse and sparsity, generalizing the parameter-efficiency and FLOPs-efficiency tradeoffs of dense, depth-recurrent, and mixture of experts architectures in one unified family. We show that LoL achieves competitive performance with all three above baselines when pretrained on text data. On synthetic sudoku and maze data, we observe that the model employs distinct layer orderings to implement different solution strategies, and we can intervene on routing to force a model to apply a specific solution strategy to a problem instance. In a multilingual natural language setting, we find that LoL chooses different layer order patterns based on language and script. Similarly, we train LoL on safety data and fit probes to its router outputs, finding that these probes distinguish safe from unsafe text with high AUROC. LoL provides a path toward a future in which models dynamically compose their own computational graph, enabling more efficient and controllable reasoning.
items.body_ko: 컴퓨터 프로그래머는 조건문이나 반복문과 같은 동일한 재사용 가능한 계산 기본 요소를 연결하지만, 다른 순서로 다른 알고리즘을 구현합니다. 이와 달리 기존의 언어 모델 아키텍처는 항상 동일한 순서로 레이어를 실행합니다. 우리는 당면한 문제를 해결하기 위해 추론 중에 레이어 순서를 동적으로 지정하는 아키텍처인 Library of Layers (LoL)를 소개합니다. LoL은 전역 트랜스포머 블록 라이브러리 크기라는 단일 하이퍼파라미터를 가지고 있으며, 이를 통해 매개변수 재사용과 희소성 사이를 원활하게 전환하여 밀집, 깊이 반복 및 전문가 혼합 아키텍처의 매개변수 효율성 및 FLOPs 효율성 균형을 하나의 통합된 패밀리로 일반화합니다. 우리는 LoL이 텍스트 데이터에 대해 사전 학습될 때 위 세 가지 기준선 모두와 경쟁적인 성능을 달성함을 보여줍니다. 합성 스도쿠 및 미로 데이터에서 모델이 다른 솔루션 전략을 구현하기 위해 고유한 레이어 순서를 사용하며, 라우팅에 개입하여 모델이 특정 문제 인스턴스에 특정 솔루션 전략을 적용하도록 강제할 수 있음을 관찰합니다. 다국어 자연어 환경에서 LoL은 언어 및 스크립트에 따라 다른 레이어 패턴을 선택한다는 것을 발견했습니다. 유사하게, 우리는 LoL을 안전 데이터에 대해 훈련하고 라우터 출력에 프로브를 장착하여 이러한 프로브가 안전한 텍스트와 안전하지 않은 텍스트를 높은 AUROC로 구별한다는 것을 발견했습니다. LoL은 모델이 자체 계산 그래프를 동적으로 구성하여 보다 효율적이고 제어 가능한 추론을 가능하게 하는 미래를 향한 길을 제공합니다.
items.title_ko: Library of Layers (LoL): 런타임에 트랜스포머 레이어 순서를 적응적으로 배열
items.summary_ko: Library of Layers (LoL)는 기존 언어 모델이 항상 동일한 순서로 레이어를 실행하는 것과 달리, 추론 중에 레이어 순서를 동적으로 배열하여 당면한 문제를 해결하는 아키텍처입니다. 이는 전역 트랜스포머 블록 라이브러리를 활용합니다.
items.why_ko: 트랜스포머 모델이 런타임에 레이어 순서를 동적으로 조정할 수 있게 되면, 다양한 태스크에 대해 훨씬 더 유연하고 효율적인 모델을 구축할 수 있어 AI 모델의 범용성과 성능을 크게 향상시킬 잠재력이 있습니다.

items.title: Grading the Unannotated: Insights from the WorkRB Skill Extraction Challenge at RecSys-HR 2026
items.body: Skill extraction benchmarks score models against a few human-annotated positives and treat every other skill in the vocabulary as equally wrong. At the scale of ESCO (13,939 skills) this binary view can reward models that rank the annotated positive high for the wrong reason, and hides semantically nonsensical predictions. The WorkRB Challenge at RecSys-HR 2026 replaces it with graded relevance: every candidate skill in a model's ranking window carries a 0 to 4 grade, and the leaderboard scores nDCG@100 against these grades. Since ternary judgements proved too coarse for objective annotation, relevance is decomposed into a cascade of four binary questions (same domain, activity mentioned, right granularity, replacement of a gold positive) that a smaller LLM judge can answer reliably; the labels are validated with blind human and frontier-model re-annotation. This paper documents the annotation methodology, the construction of five benchmark datasets (four with vacancy sentences as queries, one with lexically distant skill surface forms), the validation of the LLM cascade, and insights from the submissions. The field converged on multi-stage retrieve-and-rerank pipelines, whose gains come from clearing nonsense out of the ranking window rather than finding more positives: at the top of the leaderboard, the graded ordering is uncorrelated with what binary evaluation would have said. Graded labels expose much bigger gaps between top submissions and baselines than binary evaluation does, and show that semantic-understanding skill recommendation is still wide open. The clear next direction is bringing efficiency back: every submitted system we could size uses at least 42x, typically several hundred times, more parameters than the baselines it beats.
items.title_ko: 주석 없는 평가: RecSys-HR 2026 WorkRB 스킬 추출 챌린지 통찰
items.summary_ko: RecSys-HR 2026의 WorkRB 챌린지는 기존의 이진 평가 방식 대신 0에서 4까지의 등급으로 스킬 관련도를 평가하는 새로운 방식을 도입하여, 모델의 스킬 추출 정확도를 더 미묘하게 측정합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델 평가의 정확성과 유용성을 높이는 새로운 평가 방법론은 모델 개선과 실용적인 시스템 구축에 중요한 지표를 제공합니다.

items.title: DistDebug-Bench: Can LLM Agents Diagnose Bugs in Distributed Systems?
items.body: LLM agents show strong potential in software engineering tasks such as competitive programming and code synthesis. Existing benchmarks, however, largely focus on small-scale settings such as self-contained Python modules, leaving distributed systems, an essential class of production software, under-examined. We introduce DistDebug-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating agents' ability to diagnose complex-system failures at the code level. It curates 120 high-quality real-world bugs from 11 widely used distributed systems, spanning 5 programming languages and 10 failure patterns. Through an extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLMs and agents, we identify substantial gaps between current agents and real-world debugging tasks. A recurring gap is tunnel vision due to a lack of explicit reasoning structure and nondeterminism from inconsistent tool-use scope. The benchmark and evaluator are available at https://github.com/OrderLab/distdebug-bench, with agent traces and a leaderboard at https://distdebug.com.
items.body_ko: LLM 에이전트는 경쟁 프로그래밍 및 코드 합성 같은 소프트웨어 엔지니어링 작업에서 강력한 잠재력을 보여줍니다. 그러나 기존 벤치마크는 대부분 자체 포함된 Python 모듈과 같은 소규모 설정에 초점을 맞추고 있으며, 프로덕션 소프트웨어의 필수적인 클래스인 분산 시스템은 제대로 검토되지 않았습니다. 우리는 에이전트가 코드 수준에서 복잡한 시스템 오류를 진단하는 능력을 평가하기 위한 벤치마크인 DistDebug-Bench를 소개합니다. 이 벤치마크는 5개 프로그래밍 언어와 10개 실패 패턴에 걸쳐 11개의 널리 사용되는 분산 시스템에서 120개의 고품질 실제 버그를 큐레이션합니다. 최첨단 LLM 및 에이전트에 대한 광범위한 평가를 통해 현재 에이전트와 실제 디버깅 작업 간의 상당한 격차를 확인합니다. 반복되는 격차는 명시적인 추론 구조의 부족으로 인한 터널 비전과 일관성 없는 도구 사용 범위로 인한 비결정론입니다. 벤치마크 및 평가기는 https://github.com/OrderLab/distdebug-bench에서, 에이전트 추적 및 리더보드는 https://distdebug.com에서 확인할 수 있습니다.
items.title_ko: DistDebug-Bench: LLM 에이전트가 분산 시스템 버그를 진단할 수 있을까?
items.summary_ko: DistDebug-Bench는 LLM 에이전트가 분산 시스템의 복잡한 코드 레벨 버그를 진단하는 능력을 평가하기 위한 벤치마크입니다. 11개의 널리 사용되는 오픈소스 시스템에서 120개의 고품질 실제 버그를 큐레이션했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 복잡한 분산 시스템의 디버깅과 문제 해결에 활용될 수 있는 잠재력을 평가하는 중요한 벤치마크로, 실제 소프트웨어 개발 환경에서 AI의 생산성 향상에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: PanoTac: A Dense Three-Axis Tactile Sensor for Robust Touch-Centric Manipulation
items.body: Contact-rich manipulation benefits from tactile feedback that captures both detailed contact geometry and interaction forces. When scooping grains, contact patterns help infer spoon orientation, while resistance transmitted through the grasp guides motion. To provide these complementary sensing capabilities, we present PanoTac, a low-cost, compliant tactile fingertip designed for dense three-axis tactile sensing. Each fingertip provides a $12 \times 32 \times 3$ tactile representation, with one normal ($z$) and two shear ($x$, $y$) response components at each taxel. The sensor operates at 60 Hz and costs less than $50 per fingertip. Sensor characterization quantifies response repeatability and consistency across sensor instances and contact locations. We integrate PanoTac into a robotic system with a visuo-tactile pipeline. Across test-tube preparation, grain scooping, and salt pouring, the resulting policies outperform vision-only baselines by an average of 46.7 percentage points. Ablations show that removing either spatial contact information or shear feedback reduces overall performance across the task suite. Our project page is available at https://panotac.github.io.
items.title_ko: PanoTac: 견고한 접촉 중심 조작을 위한 조밀한 3축 촉각 센서
items.summary_ko: PanoTac은 접촉이 풍부한 조작을 위해 개발된 저비용, 유연한 촉각 센서입니다. 각 손가락 끝은 12x32x3의 촉각 표현을 제공하여 상세한 접촉 기하학 및 상호 작용 힘을 동시에 감지합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇이 미묘하고 복잡한 물리적 상호작용을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 촉각 센서 기술의 발전은 로봇 조작 능력의 핵심적인 개선을 가져옵니다.

items.title: VIAS: Value-Isolating Activation Steering for Multi-Value Alignment and Compliance for Organisations
items.body: Organisations increasingly deploy large language model agents that must follow organisational values. We check whether activation steering, which adds vectors to a model's internal activations during generation without changing its weights, can improve compliance beyond prompting alone. Since most scenarios involve several values at once, we focus on multi-value steering. A simple way to build these vectors is to contrast responses that follow all values relevant to a scenario with responses that violate them. However, this gives nearly identical vectors for different values: they capture a general compliance signal rather than individual values, which limits their use when combining several values. We propose Value-Isolating Activation Steering (VIAS), which contrasts responses to the same scenario under two prompts, one listing all relevant values and one omitting a single target value. We keep a pair only if the target value changes from compliant to non-compliant and both responses still meet a minimum compliance level on the other values. We evaluate VIAS on PROTECT, a workplace compliance dataset where each scenario is tagged with relevant values from a 21-value taxonomy. VIAS reduces overlap between value vectors, making them better suited for multi-value steering, although this alone does not lead to independent control over each value. Combined with prompting, VIAS complies with every tagged value on 69.6% of scenarios for Qwen2.5-7B, 75.2% for Mistral-7B, and 72.6% for Phi-3.5-mini, outperforming prompting alone for all three models.
items.title_ko: VIAS: 다중 가치 정렬 및 조직 준수를 위한 가치 격리 활성화 조향
items.summary_ko: VIAS(Value-Isolating Activation Steering)는 모델의 가중치를 변경하지 않고 생성 과정에서 내부 활성화에 벡터를 추가하여, LLM 에이전트가 조직의 다중 가치(multi-value)를 준수하도록 돕는 방법입니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 기업 환경에서 여러 가지 윤리적, 정책적 가이드라인을 동시에 준수하도록 훈련하는 것은 신뢰할 수 있는 AI 시스템을 구축하는 데 매우 중요합니다.

items.title: Ask, Don't Equip: Question-Driven Coding Agents for Deep Kernel Optimization
items.body: LLM agents for GPU kernel optimization sit at two ends of a structure-freedom tradeoff. Scripted agents fix what the model does at each step, via a learned policy, an optimization menu, or fixed roles, and are sample-efficient where the recipe applies and stall where it does not. Open-ended agents let a self-directed model mutate a population of kernels and pay for the freedom in trials: thousands of evaluations, repeated edits, and wrong candidates. Both respond to hard targets by equipping the agent with more: parsed profiler output, disassembly analysis, retrieval over documentation and libraries, and stores of lessons. We argue that both lack direction, a hypothesis about where the remaining gap is, and that a short question asked at the right moment supplies it without narrowing what the agent may do next. We present KernelSeek, a question-driven agent that makes an existing CUDA kernel faster with no operator-specific knowledge and no faster implementation to imitate: a general-purpose coding agent, a minimal harness that enforces a verifiable goal, and questions at decision points, first from a human, then from a bank the agent applies to itself. On the same task, evaluator, hardware, and week, a tool-rich autonomous agent built in the prevailing style plateaued at 0.50x FlashAttention-3 after 133 model-driven steps; KernelSeek reached 1.13x. It then produced dependency-free FlashAttention forward kernels for Hopper and Blackwell, single CUDA files with no CUTLASS, CuTe, cuBLAS, or cuDNN, correct on all 182 scenarios per architecture and 1.16x FlashAttention-3 and 1.46x FlashAttention-4 (geometric mean). Across 162 human messages and 11.5K agent tool calls, every large gain followed a question that moved the agent to a different layer of the system or rejected a claimed limit, never one that supplied information. We release the kernels, harness, question bank, and all traces.
items.title_ko: 질문 기반 코딩 에이전트: 깊은 커널 최적화를 위한 도구 장착 대신 질문하기
items.summary_ko: GPU 커널 최적화를 위한 LLM 에이전트는 스크립트 방식과 자유로운 방식 사이에서 균형을 이룹니다. 이 연구는 모델이 '도구를 장착'하는 대신 '질문'을 통해 최적화 목표에 도달하도록 유도하는 질문 기반 코딩 에이전트 접근법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 복잡한 최적화 작업을 수행하는 데 있어 더 효율적이고 유연한 전략을 개발하여, 고성능 컴퓨팅 및 시스템 엔지니어링 분야의 생산성 향상에 기여할 수 있습니다.

items.title: RASP: Read-All, Sparse-Plasticity Continual Learning in a Stationary-Size LoRA
items.body: Parameter-efficient continual learning on pre-trained Vision Transformers largely relies on a costly premise: preventing catastrophic forgetting requires either spawning a dedicated LoRA branch per session---causing adapter parameters to scale linearly with task horizon---or applying sparse Mixture-of-Experts gating symmetrically to both forward and backward passes, which sacrifices representational rank at test time. We argue that reading consolidated knowledge and writing new task credit are fundamentally asymmetric operations. Because visual features in a shared low-rank space distribute across rank-1 atoms rather than localizing in disjoint task silos, forward inference should read all atoms at full rank capacity, whereas backward optimization should restrict plasticity to a sparse subset of input-aligned channels. We introduce RASP (Read-All, Sparse-Plasticity LoRA), which adapts a single stationary-size adapter across sequential tasks. At each step, a scene-modulated cosine router selects the top-$q$ unlocked atoms to receive gradients, blocks updates on the remaining $r-q$ channels, and penalizes Frobenius Gram coherence between active and non-updated output directions. Across sessions, the router's empirical activation trace and each atom's exact spectral norm form a zero-overhead geometric consolidation index $ω_j = \sqrt{\tilde{c}_j \tildeσ_j}$ that drives Cauchy step attenuation and boundary anchor locking. Across CIFAR-100, CUB-200, ImageNet-R, and ImageNet-A, RASP matches or surpasses branch-expanding LoRA learners under a strictly constant parameter footprint.
items.title_ko: RASP: 고정 크기 LoRA에서 모든 것을 읽고 희소하게 학습하는 지속 학습
items.summary_ko: RASP(Read-All, Sparse-Plasticity)는 사전 훈련된 Vision Transformer에서 파라미터 효율적인 지속 학습을 위한 방법입니다. 각 세션마다 LoRA 브랜치를 생성하거나, 전방 및 역방향 패스에 희소 Mixture-of-Experts 게이팅을 적용하는 기존 방식의 한계를 극복합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델이 점진적으로 새로운 지식을 학습하고 기존 지식을 보존하는 지속 학습 능력을 효율적으로 개선하는 것은 장기적인 AI 시스템 개발에 필수적입니다.

items.title: ST-GFM: Spectral-Temporal Graph Forecasting with Measured Perturbation Bounds and Masked Spectral Reconstruction
items.body: Graph forecasters for sensor networks are trained in one regime and deployed in others, where sensor coupling and signal frequency content both change. We split this spectral shift into an operator channel and a frequency channel, each with a dimensionless measure. ST-GFM (Spectral-Temporal Graph Forecasting Model) filters every input step with Chebyshev and bidirectional diffusion filters on one learned, non-symmetric operator and alternates them with per-node temporal attention. For the operator channel we prove Frobenius-norm perturbation bounds for both graph branches, show that the Chebyshev bound is attained to first order, and compute its constant from the trained weights and the measured operator norm: 17.9 on METR-LA and 21.5 on PEMS-BAY. Under random edge dropout the trained layer moves by 2.0% to 3.1% of this bound. Masked Spectral Reconstruction (MSR), a self-supervised loss active in the first 40 epochs, matches the log power spectrum of the encoder output to that of the input. For small log-spectral residuals on unclamped bins it is proportional to an Itakura-Saito divergence to leading order. Removing it raises the 60-minute MAE by 0.30 on METR-LA, close to the 0.33 lost when all three self-supervised losses go. Under one shared evaluation pipeline, the 60-minute MAE of ST-GFM is 3.5% below a retrained STAEformer on METR-LA and 13.0% below it on PEMS-BAY. Its 60-minute MAE is 3.0980.017 on METR-LA (five seeds) and 1.5760.006 on PEMS-BAY (three seeds), the lowest PEMS-BAY MAE among twelve published baselines.
items.title_ko: ST-GFM: 측정된 섭동 경계 및 마스크된 스펙트럼 재구성을 이용한 스펙트럼-시계열 그래프 예측
items.summary_ko: ST-GFM(Spectral-Temporal Graph Forecasting Model)은 센서 네트워크에서 스펙트럼 변화(운영자 채널 및 주파수 채널)를 분리하여 예측하는 그래프 예측 모델입니다. 체비쇼프 및 양방향 확산 필터를 사용하여 입력 단계를 필터링하고 노드별 시간적 어텐션을 결합합니다.
items.why_ko: 센서 네트워크와 같은 복잡한 시스템에서 시공간적 데이터의 변화를 정확하게 예측하는 것은 스마트 도시, 환경 모니터링 등 다양한 분야에서 중요한 응용 가능성을 가집니다.

items.title: A Cross-Domain Matrix Engine for Signal Processing and Deep Neural Net Inference
items.body: Matrix multiplication dominates both PHY signal processing and Deep Neural Network (DNN) inference, yet these domains place opposing demands on the matrix engine. Signal processing requires low-latency execution of relatively small matrix operations, whereas DNN inference, particularly at large batch sizes, prioritizes high throughput and energy efficiency for large matrix multiplications. While offering efficient memory access profile, a Systolic Array (SA) adds fill and drain delays per matrix. Those can be amortized for large matrices but not for small matrices. Conversely, a tensor unit completes the kernel in few cycles but would require repeated reads of same operand tiles over large matrices. This makes SA too slow for signal processing and tensor too inefficient for AI. We show that this need not be a choice between systolic and tensor structuring of Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units. We propose a single engine that operates primarily as a SA and, through low-cost reconfiguration, transforms into a tensor-style engine on a per-operation basis. MUXes create both the spatial reduction adder tree and temporal reduction accumulators from the existing MACs and registers within the systolic array. The proposed reconfigurable SA simulated using modified SCALESim simulator, verified on an Zynq 702 FPGA and synthesized using ASAP 7nm FinFET library. SCALE-Sim simulations shows up to 7.5x lower latency for small complex value PHY kernels. Even on DNN workloads, it achieves up to 1.65x speedups over vanilla SA execution with trivial increase of memory accesses, retaining the systolic array's memory access advantage. Synthesis results estimate reconfigurable fabric costs only 8% power and 13.6% area overheads.
items.title_ko: 신호 처리 및 딥러닝 추론을 위한 교차 도메인 행렬 엔진
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 신호 처리와 딥러닝 추론 모두에서 지배적인 행렬 곱셈을 효율적으로 처리하기 위한 교차 도메인 행렬 엔진을 제안합니다. 신호 처리의 낮은 지연 시간 요구사항과 DNN 추론의 높은 처리량 요구사항을 동시에 만족시킵니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 연산 효율성을 극대화하는 하드웨어 및 아키텍처 설계는 AI 시스템의 성능 향상과 에너지 절감에 결정적인 역할을 합니다.

items.title: Can AI Do Formal Demography? Why Vaccinating the Oldest Saves Both the Most Lives and the Most Years of Life
items.body: Can AI contribute to formal demography? We report an experiment in which an AI model, Claude, was asked to explain and then simplify the proof of an earlier result: that vaccinating the oldest against COVID-19 saves both the most lives and the most years of life, because the years saved per person treated rise with age. The model proposed a new proof that is shorter, more intuitive, and somewhat more general than the original, built from a known life-table identity and the definition of convexity. It states the condition for the result as the convexity of the reciprocal of the hazard, which can be checked from the hazard alone and holds for most familiar parametric models, and it yields a lower bound on life expectancy whenever that condition is met. Prompted by a further question, the model also gave an exact form of the condition, showing how far convexity can be relaxed. The model traced these identities and related results in earlier literature. An edited record of the sessions is provided, and complete transcripts are available on request. The exercise suggests that AI can revisit established results, make them easier to understand, and prove valuable generalizations.
items.title_ko: AI는 공식 인구통계학을 할 수 있을까? 가장 나이 많은 사람에게 백신 접종이 가장 많은 생명과 생존 연수를 구하는 이유
items.summary_ko: AI 모델 Claude가 COVID-19 백신 접종의 경우 가장 나이 많은 사람에게 접종하는 것이 가장 많은 생명과 생존 연수를 구한다는 사실을 설명하고 증명하는 데 기여했습니다. 모델은 원본 증명보다 더 짧고 직관적이며 일반적인 새로운 증명을 제안했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI가 복잡한 사회 과학 문제에 대한 새로운 통찰을 제공하고 기존 연구 결과를 개선하는 데 활용될 수 있음을 보여주며, AI의 연구 보조 도구로서의 가능성을 시사합니다.

items.title: Online Label-Free Gradient Matching for Continual Language Model Training
items.body: Language models in customer-facing products must be continually updated, since the data they serve shifts over time. As retraining on the full accumulated data is impractical, each update should instead run on a small set of examples carrying the training signal of all data seen so far. The strongest current methods build this set by gradient matching, which synthesizes examples whose training gradients match those of the full data. However, they require ground-truth labels, run once on a fixed snapshot rather than on a growing stream, and are slow on large data. We introduce \textbf{OLGA}, which lifts these limitations. It distills unlabeled data by drawing the gradient matching targets from the model's own next-token predictions. Across five text classification benchmarks with phi-1.5, it improves accuracy by 10 percentage points over the strongest selection baseline using as few as five examples. OLGA also distills online data streams by keeping a running rehearsal memory of synthetic examples, which is re-distilled together with each new batch as it arrives. In the online setting, it outperforms the strongest selection-based continual baseline by 6.6 stream-AUC percentage points. Finally, our method scales to large data by pairing distillation with selection in a hybrid pipeline, letting selection handle the mild stage of compression and distillation the extreme one. It cuts runtime by 30\% versus distillation alone at similar accuracy, and beats the best selection-only pipeline by up to 12.6 percentage points.
items.title_ko: 지속적인 언어 모델 훈련을 위한 온라인 레이블 프리 기울기 매칭
items.summary_ko: 고객 대면 제품의 언어 모델은 데이터 변화에 따라 지속적으로 업데이트되어야 합니다. 이 연구는 전체 데이터를 재훈련하는 대신, 지금까지 본 모든 데이터의 훈련 신호를 담는 작은 예제 세트를 기울기 매칭을 통해 합성하는 '온라인 레이블 프리' 방법을 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM을 실제 서비스에 적용할 때 발생하는 지속적인 업데이트 문제와 효율적인 데이터 관리 문제를 해결하는 방법을 제시하여, 실용적인 AI 시스템 운영에 기여합니다.

items.title: Harder Than the Task: From Technical to Organizational Difficulty in AI Benchmarking
items.body: AI benchmarks have made remarkable progress in measuring the ability of AI systems to perform increasingly demanding cognitive and technical tasks. Yet, many of these benchmarks treat technical tasks as the unit of analysis, while much economically valuable work takes place within organizations, where tasks are embedded in a system of relations. Within organizations, successful task performance depends not only on solving the technical demands of the task but also on navigating the interdependence of activities, distributed knowledge, differentiated authority, temporal constraints, conflicting interests, and changing environmental conditions while the task is underway. Accordingly, we argue that organizational task difficulty constitutes a distinct and insufficiently recognized dimension of AI capability, and that existing approaches to benchmarking provide an incomplete basis for assessing how effectively AI agents can perform real-world organizational work. By drawing on organization theory, we develop a taxonomy of the structure of work that characterizes the conditions that agents face in organizational work. Applying this taxonomy to analyze existing benchmarks, we find limited and uneven coverage of organizational dimensions, with fewer than one quarter of prominent benchmarks claiming any of them. We therefore argue that AI benchmarks should increasingly move beyond the evaluation of technically difficult tasks toward the systematic assessment of agents' ability to navigate the organizational conditions under which economically valuable work takes place.
items.title_ko: 태스크보다 더 어려운 것: AI 벤치마킹의 기술적 난이도에서 조직적 난이도로
items.summary_ko: AI 벤치마크는 AI 시스템의 인지 및 기술적 능력을 측정하는 데 큰 진전을 보였지만, 대부분 기술적 태스크에 초점을 맞춥니다. 이 연구는 조직 내에서 태스크가 관계 시스템에 내재되어 있다는 점에서 기술적 난이도를 넘어 '조직적 난이도'를 고려해야 한다고 주장합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 시스템의 실제 가치는 기술적 능력뿐만 아니라 복잡한 조직 환경에서 다른 시스템 및 인간과 상호작용하며 문제를 해결하는 능력에 달려 있음을 강조하며, AI 벤치마킹의 새로운 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: A Hybrid Visitor Prediction Framework using Interpretable Temporal features, Integrating IQR and Anomaly Detection in Lakes in Nebraska
items.body: For effective resource management, infrastructure planning, and sustainable tourism, it is really important to predict accurate visitors. This paper estimates the daily visitation of Nebraska lakes using spatial, basic temporal, and interpretable temporal features. Moreover, we evaluate the base models with multiple metrics. Using the best three models, our method will ensemble hybrid models and choose the best hybrid technique. Further, we investigate the impact of lag features and how the models work with different outlier detection techniques such as Interquartile Range (IQR) and anomaly detection. The models are evaluated using regression metrics (MAE, MSE, RMSE, MAPE, and R2). Experiment results show that, after removing anomalies, MAE, MSE, RMSE, and MAPE are reduced. Adding lag features also shows some positive effects on the results. Moreover, anomaly detection techniques perform better than IQR in improving performance while preserving data. The reported anomaly-based cross-validation results favored the voting ensemble over the compared base models on the evaluated metrics. In anomaly-based cross-validation, VOTE improved prediction errors compared with MLP (256,128,64); improvements varied in the single-split comparison. Specifically, the hybrid model reduced MAE by 9.82%, MSE by 3.12%, RMSE by 1.76%, and MAPE by 6.77%. In the reported cross-validation comparison, the best anomaly-based hybrid model had lower MAE, MSE, RMSE, and MAPE than the best IQR-based hybrid model by 9.81%, 34.30%, 18.99%, and 0.66%, respectively.
items.title_ko: 해석 가능한 시간 특징을 이용한 하이브리드 방문객 예측 프레임워크: 네브라스카 호수 사례
items.summary_ko: 이 논문은 네브라스카 호수의 일일 방문객 수를 예측하기 위해 공간, 기본 시간, 해석 가능한 시간 특징을 활용하는 하이브리드 예측 프레임워크를 제시합니다. IQR 및 이상 탐지를 통합하여 자원 관리 및 관광 계획에 기여합니다.
items.why_ko: AI를 활용한 정확한 방문객 예측은 관광 산업 및 자원 관리 분야에서 의사결정을 개선하고 효율적인 계획 수립을 가능하게 합니다.

items.title: Identifying the Shear Piezoelectric Coefficient using Physics-Informed Neural Networks under Exact Boundary and Initial Constraints
items.body: The shear piezoelectric coefficient $e_{15}$ governs the shear-mode electromechanical coupling in piezoelectric micromachined ultrasonic transducers (PMUTs) and surface acoustic wave (SAW) devices, but measuring it typically requires destructive resonance testing on dedicated specimens. On simulated data, $e_{15}$ can instead be recovered non-destructively from sparse, noisy subsurface wavefield observations using a constrained physics-informed neural network (PINN). By building exact spatial distance functions and temporal multipliers directly into the network output, the clamped, grounded boundaries and resting initial state hold automatically, leaving the loss with only the interior equations of coupled electro-elastodynamics and the data misfit. Non-dimensional scaling brings all governing coefficients within one decade of O(1), and the setup removes the boundary and initial-condition penalty weights that soft-constraint methods must tune. In a six-way comparison (plane-strain PZT-5H, manufactured wavefield, 30 dB noise), a soft-penalty baseline with adaptive weights converges to an erroneous $e_{15}$ in four of the five runs (51.7% mean error), and fixed penalties reach an error of 0.85% only after a second-order optimization stage. The constrained formulations reach mean $e_{15}$ errors between 0.15% and 0.51% with held-out displacement errors below 1%. Within these variants, the spatial multiplier gives rapid first-order convergence, and the quadratic temporal multiplier lowers the early-time electrostatic residual by a factor of 6.8 versus a linear one. On finite-element data along one subsurface line, the full formulation recovers $e_{15}$ with 1.19% mean error at 30 dB and keeps it between 0.65% and 2.71% across a 40 to 0 dB noise sweep. Finally, training on displacements alone still recovers $e_{15}$ with mean errors of 0.45% on finite-element and 1.64% on manufactured data.
items.title_ko: 정확한 경계 및 초기 제약 조건 하에 물리 정보 신경망을 이용한 전단 압전 계수 식별
items.summary_ko: 전단 압전 계수 $e_{15}$는 압전 MEMS 및 SAW 장치의 전단 모드 전기기계 결합을 제어하지만, 측정이 어렵습니다. 이 연구는 시뮬레이션 데이터를 사용하여 제약 조건이 있는 물리 정보 신경망(PINN)을 통해 $e_{15}$를 비파괴적으로 복구하는 방법을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: PINN 기술을 활용하여 물리적 계수를 비파괴적으로 추정하는 방법은 재료 과학 및 센서 기술 개발에 중요한 공헌을 할 수 있습니다.

items.title: Tilted Convexity and an Exact Offline-Online Separation
items.body:
Convexity has three equivalent descriptions: support by affine functions, monotonicity of the subdifferential, and increasing secant slopes. We weaken all three by one distortion with parameter $γ\in(0,1]$, which multiplies positive changes by $γ$ and divides negative ones by $γ$. The resulting classes are the convex functions at $γ=1$ and, for $γ<1$, are distinct and nested, with the parameter dropping by at most a square along the chain. For proper lower semicontinuous functions in these classes, the effective domain is convex, local minimizers are global, and the function is locally Lipschitz on the relative interior of its domain.
The classes separate offline from online optimization over compact convex sets with efficient projection, with access to function values and bounded support vectors. A smooth member of any class can be minimized to additive accuracy $\varepsilon$ with $\mathrm{poly}(1/\varepsilon)$ first-order queries and projections. Online, with nonpositive losses and $α$-regret measured against $α$ times the best fixed point, a polynomial-time algorithm achieves $γ$-regret $O(\sqrt T)$ on the largest class. For every fixed, effectively specified $γ\in(0,1)$ and every $α\in(γ,1]$, no randomized polynomial-time algorithm has sublinear expected $α$-regret unless $\mathbf{NP}=\mathbf{RP}$, already for smooth concave polynomial losses in the smallest class, each minimized by one linear optimization. Thus, unless $\mathbf{NP}=\mathbf{RP}$, $γ$ is the exact online coefficient of each class, while the offline coefficient is one.
items.title_ko: 기울어진 볼록성과 정확한 오프라인-온라인 분리
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 볼록성(Convexity)의 세 가지 동등한 정의를 $γ$ 매개변수를 사용하여 약화시키는 새로운 개념인 '기울어진 볼록성(Tilted Convexity)'을 소개합니다. 이는 오프라인 및 온라인 학습 설정에서 특정 함수 클래스의 최적화 이론에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: 수학적 최적화 이론에 대한 심층 연구로, AI 모델의 학습 알고리즘 설계 및 이해에 기초적인 통찰을 제공할 수 있습니다.

items.title: A Bayesian Framework for Safe Optimal Control of Unknown Systems from Input-Output Data
items.body: As control engineering is applied to increasingly complex systems, learning-based control, which uses empirical data to reduce the reliance on first-principles models, has emerged as a promising paradigm. However, such approaches must cope with nonlinear and stochastic dynamics, the absence of state measurements, and scarce data, while ensuring safe operation under constraints, which requires rigorous uncertainty quantification. Whereas existing methods treat these challenges in isolation, this article proposes a Bayesian framework that jointly addresses them. A prior in state-space form is updated from input-output data using particle Markov chain Monte Carlo methods, yielding a representation of joint uncertainty over dynamics and latent states. Building on this representation, a validation procedure is developed that provides probabilistic guarantees for constraint satisfaction under arbitrary causal control laws. For control synthesis, a formulation penalizing the conditional value-at-risk of the constraint function is proposed, together with an adaptive calibration mechanism that adjusts the performance-robustness trade-off to achieve a desired robustness level. The probability of successful certification is characterized theoretically. The framework is extended to a receding-horizon setting, where posterior updates from new measurements allow the controller to progressively reduce uncertainty and improve performance. The approach is demonstrated on the optimal control of a vertical farm.
items.title_ko: 입력-출력 데이터로부터 미지 시스템의 안전한 최적 제어를 위한 베이즈 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: 복잡한 시스템에 대한 제어 공학에서, 불확실성 정량화를 통해 안전한 작동을 보장하면서 비선형 및 확률적 동역학, 상태 측정 부재, 희소 데이터 문제를 해결하는 베이즈 프레임워크를 제안합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 제어 시스템이 불확실성 속에서도 안전하게 작동하도록 하는 것은 자율 주행, 로봇 공학 등 고위험 분야에서 AI 적용의 신뢰성을 높이는 데 필수적입니다.

items.title: Unrolled gradients in disguise: bridging interpolation-based and Jacobian regularization for stable neural dynamics
items.body: Hybrid models and neural differential equations (NDEs) are becoming increasingly important for modelling physical systems; however, they often encounter stability and accuracy issues during long-term integration. Training on unrolled trajectories is known to limit these divergences but quickly becomes too computationally expensive due to the need to compute gradients over an iterative process, making this method impractical for large-scale physical systems (e.g. weather and climate forecasting). Two popular paradigms for improving the stability of learned dynamics are to train on interpolated or noisy samples or to regularize the Jacobian of the learned representation. In this work, we demonstrate that these paradigms can be understood under a common lens and that they both correspond to an approximation of the gradients obtained in an unrolled learning strategy. Building on this understanding, we derive a principled and complete approach to regularize training and demonstrate its impact on the stability of learned dynamical systems.
items.title_ko: 변장한 언롤링된 기울기: 안정적인 신경 동역학을 위한 보간 기반 및 야코비안 정규화 연결
items.summary_ko: 하이브리드 모델과 신경 미분 방정식(NDE)은 물리 시스템 모델링에 중요하지만, 장기 통합 시 안정성 및 정확성 문제가 있습니다. 이 연구는 '언롤링된 기울기(unrolled gradients)' 개념을 통해 안정적인 신경 동역학을 위한 보간 기반 및 야코비안 정규화 간의 연결점을 찾습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델이 물리 시스템을 더 안정적이고 정확하게 예측하도록 돕는 방법론으로, 기후 모델링, 재료 과학 등 시뮬레이션 기반 연구에 중요한 개선을 가져올 수 있습니다.

items.title: Online Class Posteriors for Interpretable and Controllable Discrete Diffusion
items.body: Discrete diffusion models remain far less understood than their continuous counterparts, despite recent breakthroughs across modalities, most notably in text. Leveraging tools from continuous diffusion, we formulate a theoretical framework to track the class-conditional posterior in an online manner by combining conditional and unconditional model predictions. In masked language modeling, this posterior offers highly interpretable dynamics: tokens aligned with a class boost the posterior, while contradictory ones suppress it. We also show that the posterior can be used for logical guidance operations (AND, OR, NOT) in discrete diffusion. These operations enable precise control over generation, such as avoiding specific classes. In addition, we discuss a mismatch in the formulation of classifier-free guidance between discrete and continuous settings: discrete models mix the data distributions, while continuous models mix the marginals. We validate our methods and discuss their potential applications on synthetic data, with all quantities analytically tractable, as well as on MNIST, text, and antibody sequences.
items.title_ko: 해석 가능하고 제어 가능한 이산 확산을 위한 온라인 클래스 사후 분포
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 이산 확산 모델(Discrete Diffusion Models)의 클래스 조건부 사후 분포를 조건부 및 무조건부 모델 예측을 결합하여 온라인으로 추적하는 이론적 프레임워크를 제시합니다. 이는 마스크된 언어 모델링에서 높은 해석 가능성을 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: 확산 모델의 내부 작동을 더 잘 이해하고 제어할 수 있게 하여, 텍스트 생성 및 기타 이산 데이터 생성 모델의 성능과 해석 가능성을 향상시키는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: Improving Hamiltonian Learning through Local Energy Decomposition
items.body: Hamiltonian neural networks provide a principled framework for learning conservative dynamics. A scalar Hamiltonian is parameterized by a neural network and the vector field is derived using Hamilton's equations. However, preserving Hamiltonian structure does not guarantee that the energy function itself is represented accurately. When modeled by a conventional multilayer perceptron, the Hamiltonian inherits the spectral bias of coordinate-based neural representations, favoring smooth over fine-scale structure. These fine-scale errors can be amplified by differentiation when computing the dynamics. To address this limitation, we introduce Local Multiscale Hamiltonian Neural Network (LM-HNN), which restructures the Hamiltonian according to its physical interaction structure. LM-HNN decomposes the energy into kinetic and potential components and represents them as sums of shared local functions over multiple interaction neighborhoods. This replaces a single high-dimensional approximation problem with lower-dimensional, reusable interaction laws, making fine-scale energy structure easier to resolve while preserving Hamiltonian dynamics. Across low-dimensional, interacting, and fast--slow systems, LM-HNN consistently achieves more accurate Hamiltonian derivatives and long-horizon rollouts than competing structure-preserving models, while substantially extending the effective spectral range of the learned energy. The same structured representation also generalizes more reliably to energy levels not observed during training. These results show that accuracy depends on the Hamiltonian representation as well as its structure, and that incorporating locality, decomposition, and shared interaction laws provides a simple and effective route to more accurate and generalizable Hamiltonian learning.
items.title_ko: 국소 에너지 분해를 통한 해밀토니안 학습 개선
items.summary_ko: 해밀토니안 신경망은 보존 동역학 학습을 위한 원리적 프레임워크를 제공하지만, 에너지 함수 자체의 정확한 표현을 보장하지 않습니다. 이 연구는 국소 에너지 분해(Local Energy Decomposition)를 통해 해밀토니안 학습을 개선하는 방법을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: 물리 시스템 모델링에서 AI가 에너지 보존 법칙과 같은 물리적 원리를 더 정확하게 학습하고 반영하도록 돕는 연구로, 과학적 발견 및 공학적 시뮬레이션의 정확성을 높일 수 있습니다.

items.title: Error Accumulation in Second-Order Sequential Machine Unlearning
items.body: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of deleted training data without full retraining. In the sequential setting, deletion requests arrive over time, and repeated updates can accumulate approximation errors. In this paper, we study error accumulation in high dimensions, where parameter count $p$ is proportional to sample size $n$, for second-order unlearning methods under two privacy settings: (i) \emph{partial unlearning}, which allows unpublished internal states to be retained while certified versions of the model are released; and (ii) \emph{perfect unlearning}, which retains only published models and no hidden states. We also distinguish pointwise and pathwise certification, depending on whether the certification guarantee applies to each released model or the whole released sequence. We analyze conjugate gradient (CG) as an efficient solver for the inverse Hessian-vector product (IHVP) in Newton iterations. Our theory shows that a maximum of 1/2/2/3 Newton--CG updates suffice for successful certification and vanishing population-risk degradation of the published model, for pointwise partial, pathwise partial, pointwise perfect and pathwise perfect certification, respectively. Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate sequential tracking and substantial computational gains of Newton-based methods combined with conjugate gradient, over gradient-based updates, especially for ill-conditioned problems.
items.title_ko: 2차 순차적 머신 언러닝의 오류 누적
items.summary_ko: 머신 언러닝(Machine Unlearning)은 삭제된 훈련 데이터의 영향을 전체 재훈련 없이 제거하려 합니다. 순차적 설정에서는 반복적인 업데이트가 근사 오류를 누적할 수 있으며, 이 연구는 2차 언러닝 방법에서 고차원 환경에서의 오류 누적을 연구합니다.
items.why_ko: 데이터 프라이버시 및 규제 준수를 위한 머신 언러닝 기술의 실용성을 높이는 데 있어, 오류 누적 문제를 이해하고 해결하는 것은 필수적입니다.

items.title: Subpolynomial-Query Proximal Sampling Beyond Log-Concavity
items.body: We study the gradient query complexity of sampling from a density $π(x)\propto\mathrm{e}^{-V(x)}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$, where $V$ has a $β$-Lipschitz gradient but need not be convex. Our approach uses the proximal sampler, which alternates Gaussian perturbation with sampling a position conditional on the noisy observation. We implement its observation chain using the high-order noisy conditional sampler of [OpenAI 2026], obtaining improved dimension dependence under functional inequalities. If $π$ satisfies a log-Sobolev inequality (LSI) with constant $α$, then for every fixed $ν>0$, there is a finite constant $C_ν$ depending only on $ν$ such that the algorithm returns a sample within total-variation distance $\varepsilon$ using at most $C_νκ(d+κ+\varepsilon^{-1}+\|\nabla V(x_0)\|^2/β)^ν$ queries, where $κ=β/α$ and $x_0$ is an arbitrary reference point for initialization. The analysis controls center-dependent local errors along exact proximal histories and removes the final observation noise by conditional decoding. Under a Poincaré inequality (PI), we obtain a corresponding guarantee from a warm start with a known bound on its Rényi divergence. An oracle lower bound shows that a stationary point alone, which suffices under LSI, is insufficient under PI.
items.title_ko: 로그-볼록성 넘어선 서브다항식 쿼리 근접 샘플링
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 밀도 $π(x) \propto e^{-V(x)}$로부터 샘플링하는 기울기 쿼리 복잡도를 서브다항식(subpolynomial) 쿼리 근접 샘플러를 사용하여 분석합니다. $V$가 볼록하지 않아도 적용 가능하며, OpenAI 2026의 고차 노이즈 조건부 샘플러를 활용하여 개선된 차원 의존성을 얻습니다.
items.why_ko: 확률 분포로부터 효율적으로 샘플링하는 기술은 생성형 AI 모델, 특히 확산 모델의 성능을 향상시키는 데 기초적인 기여를 합니다.

items.title: Playing Dumb: How a Chess Transformer Simulates Users Across Skill Levels
items.body: Generative models increasingly simulate users at different skill levels in education and AI evaluation. Yet it remains unclear whether lower-skill behavior reflects less internal knowledge or a different use of retained knowledge. This distinction is difficult to study in natural language, where proficiency and relevant knowledge are hard to measure. In this work, we study Maia-2, a chess transformer that predicts human moves conditioned on player skill, using quantitative skill ratings and deterministically labeled chess concepts. We hold board positions and model weights fixed and analyze positions where skill conditioning changes the prediction from a blunder to the best move. First, we measure encoded knowledge by training probes to predict the presence of 172 chess concepts from Maia-2's internal states. Probe accuracy remains nearly constant across skill conditions, and probes trained at one level transfer accurately to the others. To test whether stronger decisions can be recovered from this retained knowledge, we fine-tune only Maia-2's final output layer, raising best-move accuracy in the lowest skill band from 14.4% to 82.8%. Training this layer only on highest-skill representations retains most of the improvement at lower levels, showing that recovery does not require direct training on lower-skill states. Steering concept-relevant features learned by a sparse autoencoder also improves lower-skill decisions while leaving probe-measured concept encoding practically unchanged. These results support an account in which skill conditioning changes how retained concept knowledge influences move selection, showing that weaker behavior can understate the knowledge available within a model.
items.title_ko: 바둑 트랜스포머가 다양한 스킬 레벨의 사용자를 시뮬레이션하는 방법
items.summary_ko: 생성 모델이 교육 및 AI 평가에서 다양한 스킬 레벨의 사용자를 시뮬레이션하는 데 점점 더 중요해지고 있습니다. 이 연구는 체스 트랜스포머 Maia-2가 플레이어의 스킬 레벨에 따라 인간의 수를 예측하는 방법을 분석하여, 낮은 스킬 행동이 지식 부족이 아닌 다른 지식 활용 방식의 결과임을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델이 다양한 수준의 사용자 행동을 정확하게 모방하고 예측할 수 있다면, 개인 맞춤형 교육, 게임 AI, 사용자 경험 시뮬레이션 등 다양한 분야에서 AI의 활용 가치가 높아질 것입니다.

items.title: Bridging Neural Tangent Kernel Analysis and Reinforcement Learning for Deep Function Approximation
items.body: Despite their widespread success across machine learning, the learning dynamics and generalization properties of neural networks remain poorly understood. The neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides an analytical characterization of the learning dynamics of infinitely wide neural networks and serves as a useful proxy for finite-width networks in supervised learning. In this work, we extend the NTK framework to reinforcement learning (RL) by introducing a temporal-difference (TD) flow formulation that accommodates time-varying mini-batches and TD targets, yielding a closed-form solution for value function evolution in an overparametrized setting. We also devise an optimization-based state-space exploration method that leverages the closed-form solution, coupled with constraints on the environment, to model the set of feasible states. On a deterministic grid environment, we validate that the proposed RL-based NTK formulation is indeed learning efficiently and adapting to the distribution shift in the training data distribution, and we demonstrate that the resulting exploration strategy improves sample efficiency. To our knowledge, this is the first work to extend NTK theory to characterize the learning dynamics of RL training with time-varying mini-batches and TD updates.
items.title_ko: 신경 접선 커널 분석과 강화 학습을 연결하여 심층 함수 근사
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 무한히 넓은 신경망의 학습 동역학을 설명하는 신경 접선 커널(NTK) 프레임워크를 강화 학습(RL)으로 확장합니다. 시간차(TD) 흐름 공식을 도입하여 RL에서의 NTK 적용을 가능하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: NTK 이론을 강화 학습에 적용하는 것은 AI 모델의 학습 동역학을 이해하고, 더 효율적인 RL 알고리즘을 설계하는 데 중요한 이론적 기반을 제공합니다.

items.title: Optimize the Harness, Not the Model: Fitting a Minimal Agent to a Self-Hostable LLM for Investigative Analysis
items.body: Government intelligence teams need LLM agents that can analyze large, messy evidence collections, but security and cost constraints often rule out hosted frontier models and broad, hard-to-audit tool surfaces. We report CLEO: Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization, a method for fitting a minimal agent harness to a fixed, self-hostable LLM. Given an expert-validated dataset, CLEO admits only the tools, guardrails, memory policies, and loop components that improve accuracy while remaining general and auditable. On our held-out dataset, the CLEO harness reaches an 83.8% pass rate, within 1.2 points of the strongest out-of-the-box Claude Code SDK baseline, while being two orders of magnitude smaller.
items.title_ko: 모델이 아닌 하네스 최적화: 조사 분석을 위한 자체 호스팅 LLM에 최소 에이전트 맞춤
items.summary_ko: CLEO(Constrained Loop for Environment Optimization)는 고정된 자체 호스팅 LLM에 최소한의 에이전트 하네스(harness)를 맞춰 조사 분석에 활용하는 방법입니다. 전문가 검증 데이터셋을 통해 정확도를 향상시키는 도구, 가드레일, 메모리 정책, 루프 구성 요소만을 허용합니다.
items.why_ko: 보안 및 비용 제약이 있는 환경에서 LLM 에이전트의 활용성을 높이는 실용적인 방법론을 제시하며, 기업용 AI 솔루션 개발에 중요한 기여를 합니다.

items.title: A Living Leaderboard for Graph Machine Learning
items.body: Graph machine learning benchmarking results are scattered across papers that use quite different sets of datasets and baseline methods, making it difficult to tell whether a reported gain reflects architectural progress or merely an outdated comparison or weakly tuned baseline. We introduce a living, graph-learning-specific leaderboard that organizes reported results by dataset, putting new results into context. As of 15 October 2026 our LLM-based extraction pipeline extracted 27,723 eligible results across 111 datasets from 885 peer-reviewed papers. Our analysis of these results quantifies concerns about graph-learning benchmarking: legacy datasets are still actively used and many result tables contain baseline results that are drastically lower than those already available in the literature, e.g. 45% Amazon-ratings tables and 37% for Peptides-struct. The leaderboard allows to quickly compare new results against compatible prior results, aiming to improve the overall quality of graph learning benchmarking.
items.title_ko: 그래프 머신러닝을 위한 살아있는 리더보드
items.summary_ko: 그래프 머신러닝 벤치마킹 결과가 너무 분산되어 있어 비교가 어렵다는 문제점을 해결하기 위해, 데이터셋별로 보고된 결과를 정리하는 '살아있는' 그래프 학습 전용 리더보드를 소개합니다. LLM 기반 추출 파이프라인으로 데이터를 수집합니다.
items.why_ko: 그래프 머신러닝 모델의 성능을 투명하고 효과적으로 비교할 수 있는 표준화된 플랫폼은 연구 및 개발 커뮤니티에 큰 도움이 될 것입니다.

items.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
items.body: Research taste, the judgment of what to read, which problems to pursue, and which methods to try, increasingly shapes the work of AI scientists, yet it remains far less understood than their ability to execute research. We introduce IdeaTaste, a benchmark that scores an LLM by how closely the research proposals it writes from a literature snapshot frozen at 2025 match the work the same communities published in 2026. Our experiments span six contemporary language models and four research areas from established to emerging fields, covering more than 90{,}000 proposals in total. LLM agents fall well short of human communities in both the literature they cite and the ideas they state, reaching about 26\% of the human level on citation matching and only 18\% on idea matching. Their populations can cite as diversely as a community and take up its tasks and methods, yet rarely arrive at the concrete approaches and research plans it pursues. Neither richer field context nor larger populations substantially close this gap. In blinded expert review, AI proposals trail the 2026 papers least in presentation and most in expected success, echoing their gap in concrete approaches, and those whose ideas no human paper shares fare worst, suggesting weaker directions rather than overlooked opportunities. These results indicate that the main bottleneck in AI research taste lies less in finding the directions a community works on than in turning them into the concrete approaches it goes on to pursue. We release IdeaTaste as an open, continuously updated leaderboard (https://cxcscmu.github.io/IdeaTaste) that benchmarks contemporary AI proposals against future publication cycles.
items.title_ko: IdeaTaste: LLM이 인간 연구자의 연구 취향을 공유하는가?
items.summary_ko: IdeaTaste는 LLM이 인간 연구자들의 '연구 취향(research taste)'을 얼마나 잘 반영하는지 측정하는 벤치마크입니다. 2025년 기준 문헌 스냅샷으로 LLM이 작성한 연구 제안이 2026년에 실제 출판된 연구와 얼마나 일치하는지를 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: AI가 인간의 연구 과정을 보조하거나 자동화하는 데 있어, 단순한 정보 검색을 넘어 연구 아이디어의 타당성과 매력도를 평가하는 '취향'을 이해하고 모방하는 능력은 매우 중요합니다.

items.title: Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Clinical Time-Series Models
items.body: Deep learning models for electronic health records achieve strong predictive performance but provide little insight into what clinical concepts they represent internally. Post-hoc attribution methods produce per-cell importance scores that lack temporal coherence, cross-variable structure, and reusability across patients. We introduce the Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder (TI-SAE), which learns a backbone-specific, patient-shared clinical concept dictionary from a frozen predictive model's representations. Each dictionary entry (latent) is defined by learned temporal Gaussian islands (specifying when the concept is active) and a sparse variable-composition vector (specifying which variables are involved). A decoupled selector then identifies which dictionary entries drive each patient's prediction, separating representation learning from attribution. We evaluate TI-SAE across five backbone architectures spanning different representation strategies on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV (three prediction tasks each). TI-SAE produces structured clinical concepts that go beyond transient attribution heatmaps while achieving strong performance on standard faithfulness benchmarks.
items.title_ko: 임상 시계열 모델 해석을 위한 시간적 아일랜드 희소 오토인코더
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 임상 전자 건강 기록(EHR) 딥러닝 모델의 내부 작동을 해석하기 위해 Temporal Island Sparse Autoencoder (TI-SAE)를 제안합니다. TI-SAE는 고정된 예측 모델의 표현으로부터 백본별, 환자 공유 임상 개념 사전을 학습합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 AI 모델의 '블랙박스' 문제를 해결하고, 모델이 어떤 임상 개념을 기반으로 예측하는지 이해할 수 있게 하여 의료 AI의 신뢰성과 투명성을 높입니다.

items.title: Finite-Memory Control of POMDPs: Fundamental Limits and Efficient Design
items.body: Optimal control of partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs), in general, requires a complete history. The belief state, a distribution over hidden states, summarizes this history and provides the classical sufficient statistic to control POMDPs. However, the continuous nature of the belief space generally prevents a finite-memory controller from maintaining it exactly. This raises the question we address in this work: what must the available finite memory preserve to achieve near-optimal control performance? We study this question through an information-theoretic converse that gives a fundamental lower bound on the loss of any finite-memory controller. The analysis introduces the concept of a decision witness that characterizes belief states whose confusion would lead to unavoidable loss. Motivated by this bound, we propose RECAP, a constructive quantization method for designing representative memory states. We prove an upper bound on the optimality gap of any RECAP codebook and use the components of this bound together with the converse analysis to define the codebook objective. Experiments on 11 POMDP benchmarks demonstrate that RECAP improves over finite-memory representation baselines under the same memory budget.
items.title_ko: 부분 관측 마르코프 결정 과정(POMDP)의 유한 메모리 제어: 근본적 한계와 효율적 설계
items.summary_ko: 부분 관측 마르코프 결정 과정(POMDP)의 최적 제어는 일반적으로 전체 이력을 요구하지만, 믿음 상태의 연속성으로 인해 유한 메모리 컨트롤러가 이를 정확히 유지하기 어렵습니다. 이 연구는 유한 메모리가 근접 최적 제어를 위해 무엇을 보존해야 하는지 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 공학 및 자율 시스템과 같은 실세계 응용에서, 제한된 자원으로 복잡한 불확실성 환경을 제어하는 AI 시스템 설계에 중요한 이론적 기반을 제공합니다.

items.title: DeliverBench: Benchmarking AI Agents on Delivering Realistic Multi-Stage Professional Projects
items.body: LLM agents are judged by what they deliver, and in professional work what gets delivered is a project, not a task. A project pays off only if the whole package holds, and one weak part can limit the value of the rest. Yet existing benchmarks mostly test agents on one task at a time, leaving a gap between the capability we measure and the outcome that makes agents useful. To address this gap, we introduce DeliverBench, which tests whether agents can carry a project from brief to final delivery. Its 11 projects, spanning financial due diligence, legal contract drafting, and drug safety reporting, are reconstructed with 13 domain experts from real materials and chain 150 subtasks through 2-15 rounds of new materials and client feedback.
