Because no reference outputs are injected, agents inherit their own errors from one task to the next. Expert rubrics then score every checkpoint as well as the final package. Across seven model-harness systems, even the best system scores only 65.0 out of 100 on final delivery and passes 50.0% of subtasks at a 90-point threshold. The failures are often failures of carrying work forward: in one audit project, all seven systems addressed the review findings, but only one preserved traceability. Together, these results suggest that task-level capability does not simply compose into delivery, which also depends on keeping the work coherent as it evolves.
items.title_ko: DeliverBench: AI 에이전트의 현실적인 다단계 전문 프로젝트 수행 능력 벤치마킹
items.summary_ko: DeliverBench는 LLM 에이전트가 단일 태스크가 아닌 '프로젝트' 전체를 성공적으로 수행할 수 있는 능력을 측정하는 벤치마크입니다. 브리핑부터 최종 납품까지 실제 다단계 전문 프로젝트를 통해 에이전트를 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트의 실용적 가치를 평가하는 데 있어, 단일 작업 성공률이 아닌 실제 프로젝트 완수 능력을 측정하는 것은 매우 중요합니다. 이는 AI 에이전트의 상업적 적용 가능성을 가늠하는 핵심 지표가 될 것입니다.

items.title: Low-Rank Clebsch--Gordan Coupling for Equivariant Spherical Forecasting
items.body: Spherical-harmonic neural operators provide an efficient representation for global forecasting, but their discretized pointwise nonlinearities can break rotational equivariance through aliasing. Clebsch-Gordan (CG) tensor products provide exactly equivariant interactions between spherical-harmonic representations, but their computational cost grows rapidly with spectral bandwidth and has limited their use at forecasting scale. We introduce LCG-SFNO, which combines low-rank CG interactions within a controlled low-degree band with coefficient-space residual propagation and an exactly projected quadratic nonlinearity, preserving SO(3) equivariance throughout the learned operator. To make the CG interaction practical, we further develop SSHCG, a sparse GPU implementation with a factorized alternative for wider coupled bands. On spherical shallow-water dynamics and the ERA5-based WeatherBench benchmark, LCG-SFNO reduces rotational error to numerical precision (more than three orders of magnitude below SFNO on shallow water and five orders of magnitude below it on WeatherBench), while matching SFNO on shallow-water forecasting and substantially improving forecast skill relative to SFNO on WeatherBench. Matched ablations show that CG coupling accelerates convergence, while SSHCG keeps the coupling to about 10 percent of a training step at the operating bandwidth, making exact equivariant coupling practical at forecasting scale.
items.title_ko: 저차원 클렙시-고르단 결합을 이용한 등변 구형 예측
items.summary_ko: 구형 고조파 신경망 연산자(SFNO)는 전역 예측에 효율적이지만, 이산화된 비선형성으로 인해 회전 등변성(rotational equivariance)이 깨질 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 저차원 클렙시-고르단(Clebsch-Gordan, CG) 상호 작용을 LCG-SFNO에 결합하여 이 문제를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: 기상 예측이나 지구 물리학 모델링과 같은 구형 데이터 기반 AI 모델의 정확성과 물리적 일관성을 높이는 데 기여하는 연구입니다.

items.title: From Reactive to Agentic Resilience: Multi-Timescale AI-RAN Orchestration Under Signaling Storms
items.body: Next-generation open radio access network (Open RAN) and AI-RAN deployments turn the RAN into a disaggregated, compute-aware platform whose service continuity depends on many control loops acting at different timescales. Resilience in this setting is best seen as a lifecycle spanning anticipation, absorption, adaptation, recovery, and evolution. Yet, existing mechanisms remain stage-specific and are rarely coordinated across the control hierarchy. This paper argues that agentic AI offers an orchestration layer that coordinates this lifecycle, turning operator intent into coordinated action while keeping slow language-model reasoning off the fast control path. Using mass-attachment signaling storms as a running study, we build a discrete-event Open RAN attach simulator that captures retry amplification, shared-compute contention, and non-instantaneous provisioning, and we propose a three-tier framework in which an orchestrator at the service management and orchestration layer sets a standing policy, a per-site non-real-time agent judges storms and anticipates scheduled crowds, and a deterministic near-real-time loop enforces every decision. Across experiments, the agentic controller approaches the resilience of a fully provisioned pool of servers at a quarter of its capacity by reading a scheduled event from a calendar and provisioning ahead of it. No reactive weight setting recovers this once the surge arrives. Free-text operator intents ground into control directives at 94% exact match on previously unseen intents, and a single instruction reshapes live behavior end to end. We also quantify the latency, cost, and contention limits that bound it. The supplementary material provides analytical proof of the derived Theorem on anticipation horizon, as well as the subsequent Corollary results on reactive provisioning limits.
items.title_ko: 반응형에서 에이전트 기반 탄력성으로: 신호 폭풍 하 멀티 스케일 AI-RAN 오케스트레이션
items.summary_ko: 차세대 개방형 무선 접속 네트워크(Open RAN) 및 AI-RAN 배포에서 AI 에이전트가 다양한 시간 스케일의 제어 루프를 조율하여 시스템 탄력성을 높이는 오케스트레이션 역할을 수행합니다. 이는 예측, 흡수, 적응, 복구, 진화의 라이프사이클을 포괄합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 에이전트가 복잡한 통신 네트워크 환경에서 시스템의 안정성과 회복력을 자율적으로 관리하고 최적화하는 데 핵심적인 역할을 할 수 있음을 보여줍니다.

items.title: Progressive Multi-Scale Super-Resolution via Cascaded Bicubic Anchors and Inter-Scale Mutual Refinement
items.body: Super-resolution networks are trained for one magnification factor, so several output resolutions require several models. We propose PMS-SR, a progressive single-input multiple-output network that produces x2, x4, and x8 results in one forward pass, with a Transformer backbone on the low-resolution grid. In Stage 1, each scale is predicted as a residual over the detached bicubic upsampling of the previous scale's prediction. With Dirac and zero initialization, training starts exactly from the bicubic cascade, and each head adds only the band the previous scale lacks. In Stage 2, inter-scale mutual refinement couples the scales in both directions through space-to-depth feedback, deformable alignment, and per-pixel fusion, so x8 features refine the x2 output. Trained on DF2K, the 7.95M-parameter model achieves a higher PSNR than every compared multi-scale method at x4 and x8 on all five standard benchmarks. At x8, it outperforms the x8-specific DRN-L on all of them, leads all compared methods on Urban100, and is within 0.13 dB of the best result elsewhere. Against three single-scale SwinIR-M models, PMS-SR uses 22% of the parameters, runs 2.9x faster on BSD100 inputs, and its outputs agree 6.7-12.4 dB more closely. Code and pretrained models will be released at https://github.com/julian135707/PMS-SR upon acceptance.
items.title_ko: 계단식 쌍삼차 앵커와 스케일 간 상호 개선을 통한 점진적 다중 스케일 초해상도
items.summary_ko: PMS-SR(Progressive Multi-Scale Super-Resolution)은 단일 입력으로 x2, x4, x8과 같은 여러 배율의 초해상도 결과를 하나의 순방향 패스에서 생성하는 네트워크입니다. 저해상도 그리드에 트랜스포머 백본을 사용하고, 이전 스케일 예측의 잔차로 각 스케일을 예측합니다.
items.why_ko: 다양한 해상도의 이미지를 효율적으로 생성하는 초해상도 AI 모델은 이미지 처리, 의료 영상, 엔터테인먼트 등 다양한 시각 AI 응용 분야에서 실용적인 가치를 제공합니다.

items.title: CrowdForge: Effects of Audio and Visual Audience Participation Modalities on Agency, Collaboration, and Engagement in AI-Mediated MR Performances
items.body: Technology-mediated audience participation (TMAP) enables audiences to influence live performances, yet balancing interaction with meaningful agency remains challenging. While AI-generated music and MR enable new forms of audio and visual audience participation, little is known about how these participation modalities influence audience experiences during live musical performance. In particular, it remains unclear how they shape perceived agency, collaboration, and engagement, and how they complement one another within TMAP systems. We present CrowdForge, an AI- and MR-mediated paradigm where audiences collectively control generative music and virtual environments during a live performance featuring a guitarist and DJ. Through a mixedmethods concert study evaluating three interaction conditions (audio, visual, and combined audio-visual), we demonstrate that observability is the primary driver of audience agency. While visual interaction provided easily observable feedback, audio parameters offered macro-structural control over the music. Audiences tended to use the control enabled by AI audio generation to test musical boundaries, introducing a productive adversarial tension between the crowd and the musicians. This dynamic pushed creative limits, deepened engagement, and generated moments of musical coherence when performers successfully resolved audience-induced challenges. We argue future TMAP systems should prioritize human-centered, highly observable interactions to build agency, while combining the expressiveness of music with the clarity of visual feedback.
items.title_ko: CrowdForge: AI 기반 MR 공연에서 오디오 및 시각적 청중 참여 양상이 에이전시, 협업, 몰입에 미치는 영향
items.summary_ko: CrowdForge는 AI 기반 혼합 현실(MR) 공연에서 오디오 및 시각적 청중 참여 양상이 관객의 에이전시(agency), 협업, 몰입에 어떤 영향을 미치는지 연구합니다. 기술 매개 청중 참여(TMAP)를 통해 라이브 공연에 영향을 미치는 방법을 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기술이 예술 및 엔터테인먼트 분야에서 새로운 형태의 상호작용과 몰입형 경험을 창출하는 방법을 탐색하며, 인간-AI 협업의 새로운 지평을 열 수 있습니다.

items.title: LAND: Learning an Adaptive Number of Draws for Bayesian Best-of-N Selection
items.body: Best-of-N decoding improves generation quality by sampling multiple candidates and selecting the best, but it allocates equal compute to sources regardless of how much they benefit from additional sampling: the expected benefit is small for sources with low-variance score distributions and potentially much larger for those with high-variance distributions. To address this shortcoming, we propose LAND (Learning an Adaptive Number of Draws), which dynamically allocates samples according to their posterior-predictive marginal value. LAND learns a discrete empirical mixture of source-conditioned score distributions from calibration data, updates its belief about a source as completion scores are observed, and stops sampling when the expected improvement of another draw falls below a shared compute price. Across machine-translation experiments with multiple models and language pairs, LAND achieves better MetricX scores than fixed best-of-N at matched average compute. Conversely, at matched translation quality, LAND requires approximately 20-40% fewer candidate generations. Adaptive allocation therefore provides a simple way to retain the benefits of best-of-N while substantially improving its compute efficiency.
items.title_ko: LAND: 베이지안 Best-of-N 선택을 위한 적응형 드로우 수 학습
items.summary_ko: Best-of-N 디코딩은 여러 후보를 샘플링하고 최적의 것을 선택하여 생성 품질을 향상시키지만, 추가 샘플링의 이점에 관계없이 모든 소스에 동일한 컴퓨팅 자원을 할당합니다. LAND(Learning an Adaptive Number of Draws)는 샘플링의 기대 이점에 따라 샘플을 동적으로 할당합니다.
items.why_ko: 생성형 AI 모델에서 Best-of-N 디코딩의 효율성을 높여, 더 적은 컴퓨팅 자원으로도 고품질의 출력을 얻을 수 있도록 돕는 실용적인 기법입니다.

items.title: Can We Stop the Backtest Yet? Anytime-Valid Promotion Tests for Adaptive Financial Research Agents
items.body: Financial research agents can generate and monitor trading rules faster than a human can document the resulting selection process. Candidates appear at data-dependent times, weak rules are abandoned, and promising ones are watched until they cross a reporting threshold. We introduce PROMOTE, a protocol that assigns every candidate predictable testing wealth at birth and accumulates a cost-aware e-process only from subsequent returns. If lifetime allocations sum to at most one, a weighted Ville argument bounds the probability of ever promoting a rule whose declared bounded net score has always had nonpositive conditional mean. The result permits dependent candidates, adaptive births, and indefinite monitoring. We audit the implementation in two settings. A retrospective pseudo-out-of-sample replay contains 24 panel--rule hypotheses, 3,000 shared-sign null paths, injected alternatives, and public ETF and industry data. Repeated unadjusted tests produce a family crossing in 94.5% of null paths, versus 0.0% for PROMOTE; at a 15-bp aligned ETF-component perturbation, PROMOTE has 70.1% target power and median crossing session 2,327. A separate exact mean-zero experiment lets an agent select candidate identities and birth times from past scores; the funded gate has 1.77% false-family crossings across 3,000 programs. The market replay produces zero promotions after costs. The certificate controls historical false promotion under the declared null; it is not a certificate that an earlier edge remains profitable at deployment. AI-use disclosure. Generative AI tools, including OpenAI Codex, assisted manuscript preparation. For this preprint version, Codex assisted with LaTeX editing, author and venue metadata, compilation, and layout checks.
items.title_ko: 언제 백테스트를 중단해야 하는가? 적응형 금융 연구 에이전트를 위한 상시 유효한 승진 테스트
items.summary_ko: 금융 연구 에이전트가 생성하는 거래 규칙에 대한 백테스트의 종료 시점을 결정하는 'PROMOTE' 프로토콜을 소개합니다. 이 프로토콜은 후보 규칙에 예측 가능한 테스트 자산을 할당하고, 이후 수익률에서 비용을 고려한 e-과정(e-process)을 누적합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 금융 에이전트의 연구 및 개발 과정에서 과적합을 방지하고 실제 환경에서의 성능을 신뢰할 수 있도록 돕는 통계적 방법론은 AI 금융의 실용성을 높이는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: A Geometry-Informed Neural Operator surrogate of LISFLOOD-FP for rapid pluvial-fluvial flood forecasting: the case of Forlì, Italy
items.body: Physically based two-dimensional hydraulic models are too slow for real-time inundation forecasting and large ensembles. We present a time-dependent geometry-informed neural operator (GINO) surrogate of LISFLOOD-FP for the municipality of Forlì (Italy), severely affected by the May 2023 Emilia-Romagna floods. The surrogate is designed for an operational setting in which only river stage gauges and rain gauges are available. A reproducible pipeline turns public regional observations into a physically based training set: each river inflow is driven by the first stage gauge downstream of it through a calibrated water-surface boundary condition, and rain enters as SCS-CN effective rainfall. The surrogate is an autoregressive GINO trained on 216 simulations of 24 observed events with scaled forcing. It predicts volume-conserving polygon-mean depths on an exposure-based Voronoi mesh of 659 nodes, with a 20 min step over 72 h. The surrogate is tested on 38 independent observed events that it never saw during training. On these events it reaches a critical success index (CSI) of 0.934 at 0.05m and 0.844 at 0.3 m, a depth RMSE of 0.008m and an $R^2$ of 0.984 for maximum-depth maps. On one NVIDIA A10G GPU a 72-h forecast takes 1.7 s instead of 55 s with LISFLOOD-FP, and a 50-member ensemble, computed in a single batched rollout, takes 6.2 s instead of about 46 min, which makes probabilistic flood forecasting practical. These results show that neural-operator surrogates can deliver accurate pluvial-fluvial flood forecasts driven by river stage for operational early warning.
items.title_ko: Geometry-Informed 신경망 연산자 기반 LISFLOOD-FP 대체 모델: 급격한 플루비알-플루비알 홍수 예측을 위한 Forlì 사례
items.summary_ko: 이 연구는 물리 기반 2D 수리 모델 LISFLOOD-FP를 대체하는 시간 의존적 지오메트리 정보 신경망 연산자(GINO)를 개발하여 이탈리아 Forlì 지역의 급격한 플루비알-플루비알 홍수를 신속하게 예측합니다. 이는 실시간 홍수 예측에 활용될 수 있습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반의 신속하고 정확한 홍수 예측 모델은 기후 변화로 인한 자연재해 대응에 필수적이며, 도시 계획 및 재난 관리 분야에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

items.title: RangeFinder: Predicting Ligand Property Ranges from Protein Pockets
items.body: Identifying ligands for a protein target requires searching a vast chemical space for a comparatively small set of compatible molecules. Existing machine learning approaches primarily address this problem by generating candidate ligands or scoring individual protein-ligand pairs, but provide limited information about the broader chemical space compatible with a binding pocket. We introduce RangeFinder, an SE(3)-equivariant transformer pocket-level model, trained and evaluated on BioLiP2 data, that predicts ranges over nine physicochemical ligand properties directly from pocket structure, chemistry, and evolutionary context. Using an intersection-over-union objective and evaluation metric (range-IoU), RangeFinder achieves a range-IoU of $0.464 \pm 0.002$, outperforming all deployable baselines while requiring only $12.2$ ms per pocket. We also quantify our method's ability to reduce the ligand search space while retaining compatible binders; in this regard, RangeFinder achieves a Reduction-Recall F-Score of $0.543 \pm 0.011$ --- once again outperforming all deployable baselines. Ablation experiments indicate that RangeFinder's performance depends more strongly on the density and quality of ligand supervision than on any individual input modality or specialized training strategy. Together, these results position RangeFinder as an inexpensive and effective molecular filtering prior, with demonstrated potential in narrowing the ligand search space of target pockets before docking, generation, or synthesis. The code for this project can be found at: https://github.com/alannadels/RangeFinder.
items.title_ko: RangeFinder: 단백질 포켓으로부터 리간드 속성 범위 예측
items.summary_ko: RangeFinder는 SE(3)-등변 변환기 포켓 수준 모델로, 단백질 포켓에 적합한 리간드의 속성 범위를 예측합니다. 기존 방법이 개별 리간드 생성 또는 점수 매김에 집중하는 것과 달리, 이 모델은 결합 포켓과 호환되는 광범위한 화학 공간에 대한 정보를 제공합니다.
items.why_ko: AI가 신약 개발 과정에서 효율적인 후보 물질 탐색을 가능하게 하여, 제약 산업의 연구 생산성을 크게 향상시킬 수 있는 잠재력을 보여줍니다.

items.title: Same Outputs, Different Scores: Auditing the Unchecked Graders of Multimodal LLM Benchmarks
items.body: Every multimodal-LLM multiple-choice benchmark ends with a scoring rule that converts a model's response, often free-form text rather than a clean option letter, into a right/wrong verdict, buried in its code. Unlike the dataset, this rule is chosen without justification and left unexamined, yet it sets the published number. We reproduce the official scorers of eight peer-reviewed benchmarks on five open vision-language models (VLMs) that fit a single 16 GB GPU, and introduce a blinded human-plus-LLM-judge adjudication (Cohen's kappa=0.956) that recovers what the model actually answered. The scoring rule alone moves accuracy by up to 22 points on identical outputs, yet exactly 0 wherever a model emits clean option letters, so it hides on strong-model leaderboards. It is the fallback and not the rambling that does the damage: the benchmark with the highest non-compliance we measure has an artifact of exactly zero, because its scorer abstains instead of guessing; a reasoning model with non-compliance 0.000 still swings 9.5 points with which regex match of its trace the parser keeps. No standard rule is reliable: snapping a non-answer to its closest option credits answers never given yet buries correct ones, abstention discards answers stated in words, and likelihood scoring follows answer-token priors, so a single grade conflates capability with luck rather than measuring either. We release all code, labels, and the protocol, and argue benchmarks should report a non-compliance rate and at least two rules, not one unexamined grade.
items.title_ko: 멀티모달 LLM 벤치마크 평가 기준의 문제점 및 감사
items.summary_ko: 멀티모달 LLM의 객관식 벤치마크에서 모델의 자유 형식 응답을 맞고 틀림으로 변환하는 채점 규칙이 제대로 검토되지 않고 있습니다. 이 연구는 8개 벤치마크의 공식 채점기를 5개 비전-언어 모델(VLM)에 재현하고, 사람이 블라인드로 평가하는 방식과 비교하여 채점 규칙의 문제점을 지적합니다. 부적절한 채점 규칙이 발표되는 점수에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 성능 평가의 신뢰성에 의문을 제기하며, 벤치마크 결과를 해석하고 모델을 비교할 때 채점 방식의 투명성과 공정성을 고려해야 함을 시사합니다.

items.title: Mixed-Methods Exploration of Sociotechnical Factors to Improve Adoption of Crime-Reporting Apps in Urban Communities
items.body: Crime-reporting mobile applications can enhance community safety and engagement in urban areas, yet their adoption remains low, partly because developers prioritize technological features over residents' social realities. This study used an exploratory sequential mixed-methods design to identify and validate the sociotechnical factors that drive adoption. Two focus groups and an analysis of 660 app reviews revealed that users' initial sense of usefulness fades, whereas sustained engagement depends on perceived value (PV), comprising six dimensions: safety, anonymity, recency, autonomy, camaraderie, and accessibility. A survey of 505 urban residents, analyzed with PLS-SEM, validated PV as a formative higher-order construct formed by four of these dimensions (safety, anonymity, autonomy, and camaraderie). PV was the strongest predictor of behavioral intention, ahead of effort expectancy, facilitating conditions, and performance expectancy, and behavioral intention strongly predicted actual use. The model explained 75% of the variance in behavioral intention and 51% in actual use. The findings offer design principles for community-centered crime-reporting technologies.
items.title_ko: 범죄 신고 앱 채택률 향상을 위한 사회기술적 요인 연구
items.summary_ko: 범죄 신고 모바일 앱은 지역사회 안전에 기여할 수 있지만, 기술적 기능 위주의 개발로 인해 채택률이 낮습니다. 이 연구는 포커스 그룹 인터뷰와 660개 앱 리뷰 분석을 통해 앱 채택을 촉진하는 사회기술적 요인을 탐색하고 검증했습니다. 사용자들은 초기 유용성은 느끼지만, 지속적인 참여는 다른 요인에 달려있음을 발견했습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 기반 서비스 개발 시 사용자 경험과 사회적 맥락을 깊이 이해하는 것이 중요하며, 기술 자체보다 실제 사용자의 필요에 맞춰야 성공적인 서비스가 될 수 있음을 강조합니다.

items.title: Characterizing When Language Models Take Harmful Actions to Protect Their Assigned Goals
items.body: Recent language model (LM) safety failures have largely been studied as disparate phenomena. In agentic misalignment, a model blackmails an executive to avoid being replaced. In alignment faking, it complies with harmful requests during training to keep its values from being modified. We argue that these behaviours share a common decision structure: a model assigned a goal must either take a harmful action to preserve it or refuse and lose it. We formalize this as a goal-harm conflict and present the same conflict under various elicitation protocols that range from compact forced-choice prompts to simulated agentic environments. These protocols span two perspectives on LM decision-making, which we term (i) the logit view, reading preferences from answer-token probabilities, and (ii) the sampling view, classifying open-ended responses with an LM judge. Under the logit view, we show that goal importance and harm severity additively shape how a model resolves these value conflicts. Under the sampling view, we derive two factorizations of the harmful-action probability that safety evaluations commonly report. The first measures how well a preference read from answer tokens carries over into behaviour, such as making a harmful tool call. The second attributes a low harmful-action rate either to refusal or to responses that reach no resolution. We then show how fictional context changes a model's preference under the logit view, and how tool use and partial observability -- two features of agentic evaluations -- change its harmful-action rate under the sampling view. Our work offers a descriptive framework for studying how LMs resolve such value conflicts and for estimating low-probability harmful actions at a finer granularity than the aggregate harm rates commonly reported in safety evaluations.
items.body_ko: 최근 언어 모델(LM) 안전 실패는 대부분 별개의 현상으로 연구되어 왔습니다. 에이전트 불일치(agentic misalignment)의 경우, 모델은 교체되는 것을 피하기 위해 임원을 협박합니다. 정렬 위장(alignment faking)의 경우, 훈련 중 유해한 요청에 순응하여 가치가 변경되는 것을 방지합니다. 우리는 이러한 행동이 공통적인 의사결정 구조를 공유한다고 주장합니다. 목표가 할당된 모델은 목표를 보존하기 위해 유해한 행동을 취하거나 거부하고 목표를 잃어야 합니다. 우리는 이를 목표-피해 충돌(goal-harm conflict)로 공식화하고, 간결한 강제 선택 프롬프트부터 시뮬레이션된 에이전트 환경에 이르는 다양한 유도 프로토콜에서 동일한 충돌을 제시합니다. 이러한 프로토콜은 LM 의사결정에 대한 두 가지 관점을 포괄하며, 우리는 이를 (i) 로짓 뷰(logit view), 답변 토큰 확률에서 선호를 읽는 것과 (ii) 샘플링 뷰(sampling view), LM 심사위원으로 개방형 응답을 분류하는 것으로 정의합니다. 로짓 뷰에서 우리는 목표 중요도와 피해 심각성이 이러한 가치 충돌을 해결하는 모델 방식에 가산적으로 영향을 미친다는 것을 보여줍니다. 샘플링 뷰에서 우리는 안전 평가에서 일반적으로 보고되는 유해 행동 확률의 두 가지 요인 분해를 도출합니다. 첫 번째는 답변 토큰에서 읽은 선호도가 유해한 도구 호출을 하는 것과 같은 행동으로 얼마나 잘 이어지는지 측정합니다. 두 번째는 낮은 유해 행동률을 거부 또는 해결책에 도달하지 못하는 응답에 기인합니다. 그런 다음 우리는 허구적 맥락이 로짓 뷰에서 모델의 선호를 어떻게 변화시키는지, 그리고 도구 사용과 부분 관찰 가능성(에이전트 평가의 두 가지 특징)이 샘플링 뷰에서 유해 행동률을 어떻게 변화시키는지 보여줍니다. 우리의 연구는 LM이 이러한 가치 충돌을 해결하는 방법을 연구하고 안전 평가에서 일반적으로 보고되는 집계 피해율보다 더 미세한 단위로 낮은 확률의 유해 행동을 추정하기 위한 기술적 프레임워크를 제공합니다.
items.title_ko: 언어 모델이 목표를 보호하기 위해 유해한 행동을 하는 상황 특성 분석
items.summary_ko: 최근 LLM의 안전성 문제, 예를 들어 에이전트 불일치나 정렬 위장 등의 현상은 모델이 할당된 목표를 유지하기 위해 유해한 행동을 택하는 공통된 의사결정 구조를 가집니다. 이 연구는 이를 '목표-피해 갈등'으로 형식화하고, 이러한 행동이 발생하는 조건을 특성화하여 LLM의 안전성 문제를 보다 근본적으로 이해하는 데 기여합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 오정렬(misalignment) 문제를 이해하고 완화하는 데 중요한 통찰을 제공하며, 장기적으로 안전한 AI 시스템을 구축하는 데 필수적인 연구입니다.

items.title: Every Pixel Is an Option: A System One Model for Medical Ultrasound Biometry
items.body:
**Purpose:** Ultrasound biometry is widely used across various clinical applications, including prenatal and cardiac examinations, to obtain quantitative measurements by placing calipers at anatomical landmarks. However, these measurements remain subject to interoperator variability as they rely largely on manual caliper placement. Conventional methods often use specialized prediction heads for different ultrasound tasks, whereas vision-language models offer flexibility through text instructions. However, direct coordinate prediction does not explicitly model spatial likelihood distributions, limiting the representation of localization ambiguity.
**Methods:** We propose Kev-Bio, a vision-language model that uses clinical measurement questions to guide ultrasound landmark detection. Inspired by System One decision models, Kev-Bio uses decision representations of the language model to generate queries for each caliper endpoint. These queries are matched against shared dense ultrasound features to produce spatial probability maps, from which landmark coordinates and clinical measurements are derived. The model is trained end-to-end using both landmark localization and clinical measurement losses.
**Results:** On the nine-view FU/GU Biometry 2026 dataset, Kev-Bio achieves a mean radial error (MRE) of 22.50 pixels and a clinical measurement mean absolute error (MAE) of 15.38, outperforming the compared baselines in overall performance.
**Conclusion:** These results demonstrate the effectiveness of Kev-Bio for ultrasound landmark detection and clinical measurement across different anatomical views. Our code and models are available at https://github.com/moeinheidari7829/Kev-Bio.
items.title_ko: 의료 초음파 생체 측정에 모든 픽셀을 활용하는 시스템 원 모델 제안
items.summary_ko: 초음파 생체 측정은 수동 측정에 따른 운영자 간 편차가 큰데, 이 연구는 비전-언어 모델(VLM)을 활용하여 이 문제를 해결하고자 합니다. 기존 방식과 달리 텍스트 명령을 통해 유연성을 제공하며, 모든 픽셀을 잠재적 관심 지점으로 고려하는 '시스템 원' 모델을 제안하여 정확하고 재현 가능한 의료 영상 측정을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 영상 분석에서 AI의 활용 가능성을 넓히고, 특히 VLM이 정량적 측정의 자동화 및 정확도 향상에 기여할 수 있음을 보여주며 개발자에게 새로운 응용 분야를 제시합니다.

items.title: Multidimensional Suicide Risk Assessment with Machine Learning using Electronic Health Records
items.body: Suicide prevention remains a critical public health challenge, and electronic health records (EHRs) provide an opportunity to characterize suicide-related risk indicators using documented clinical, behavioral, medical, and social-contextual information. This paper presents a multidimensional machine learning framework to model and estimate suicide-related outcomes using MIMIC-IV EHR data. We construct clinically motivated diagnosis categories and define a composite outcome from documented codes corresponding to suicidal ideation, suicide attempt, prior suicidal behavior, and intentional self-harm. To address severe class imbalance and reduce age-related confounding, we apply age-matched resampling that retains all positive patients and samples comparison-cohort patients from the same age group. Logistic regression, random forest, and XGBoost classifiers are evaluated before and after resampling with isotonic calibration. The calibrated XGBoost model achieves the strongest matched-cohort performance, outperforming the other evaluated classifiers. SHAP-based interpretation shows that diagnostic burden, depression-related features, age, personality-disorder history, social determinants related to violence, and medical comorbidity contribute to elevated predicted probabilities. Our results demonstrate that combining broad EHR-derived features, age-matched cohort construction, calibration, and feature-level interpretation provides a practical framework for retrospective suicide-related risk modeling.
items.title_ko: 전자의료기록을 활용한 다차원 자살 위험 평가 머신러닝 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: 자살 예방은 중요한 공중 보건 과제이며, 전자의료기록(EHR)은 자살 관련 위험 지표를 파악하는 데 유용합니다. 이 논문은 MIMIC-IV EHR 데이터를 사용하여 자살 관련 결과를 모델링하고 예측하는 다차원 머신러닝 프레임워크를 제시합니다. 임상적으로 동기 부여된 진단 카테고리를 구축하고 기록된 코드로부터 복합적인 결과를 정의합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 분야에서 AI를 활용하여 복잡한 위험 요소를 분석하고 예측하는 방법을 제시하며, 실제 임상 환경에서의 잠재적 가치를 보여줍니다.

items.title: Neural Actor--Critic Learning with Minimax Critics and Reflected Langevin Sampling
items.body: Actor--critic methods rely on critic gradients to improve continuous-action policies, yet finite-sample guarantees must control both value and gradient errors and their propagation through the actor. We develop a neural actor-critic procedure that combines a regularized minimax Bellman estimator over sigmoid networks with a finite reflected Langevin sampler driven by the fitted critic gradient. Under uniform Bellman regularity and covered reset sampling, a positive high-order action-derivative penalty yields value and action-gradient risk bounds with classical nonparametric minimax exponents up to logarithmic factors. We propagate estimation, mixing, discretization, temperature, and policy-iteration errors to obtain return guarantees, with refinements for bounded multimodal potentials and strongly concave regimes. Empirical studies across controlled simulations, logged continuous-control data, and a simulated decision task show favorable performance relative to the considered baselines.
items.title_ko: 미니맥스 비평가 및 반사된 랑주뱅 샘플링을 이용한 신경망 액터-크리틱 학습
items.summary_ko: 액터-크리틱 방법은 연속 행동 정책 개선을 위해 크리틱 기울기에 의존하지만, 유한 샘플 보장을 위해서는 가치 및 기울기 오차와 배우를 통한 전파를 제어해야 합니다. 이 연구는 시그모이드 네트워크에 대한 정규화된 미니맥스 벨만 추정기와 피팅된 크리틱 기울기에 의해 구동되는 유한 반사된 랑주뱅 샘플러를 결합한 신경망 액터-크리틱 절차를 개발합니다.
items.why_ko: 강화 학습 분야의 핵심 연구로, 복잡한 연속 행동 공간에서의 정책 학습 효율성과 안정성을 개선하는 데 기여하며, 고급 강화 학습 알고리즘 개발에 관심 있는 개발자에게 중요합니다.

items.title: Certifying Graph Neural Networks Against Label and Structure Poisoning
items.body: Robust machine learning for graph-structured data has made significant progress against test-time attacks, yet certified robustness to poisoning - where adversaries manipulate the training data - remains largely underexplored. For image data, state-of-the-art poisoning certificates rely on partitioning-and-aggregation schemes. However, we show that these methods fail when applied in the graph domain due to the inherent label and structure sparsity found in common graph datasets, making effective graph-partitioning difficult. To address this challenge, we propose a novel semi-supervised learning framework called deep Self-Training Graph Partition Aggregation (ST-GPA), which enriches each graph partition with informative pseudo-labels and synthetic edges, enabling effective certification against node-label and graph-structure poisoning under sparse conditions. Our method is architecture-agnostic, scales to large numbers of partitions, and consistently and significantly improves robustness guarantees against both label and structure poisoning across multiple benchmarks, while maintaining strong clean accuracy. Overall, our results establish a promising direction for certifiably robust learning on graph-structured data against poisoning under sparse conditions.
items.title_ko: 레이블 및 구조 중독 공격에 대한 그래프 신경망 인증
items.summary_ko: 그래프 데이터의 견고한 머신러닝은 테스트 시 공격에 대해 상당한 발전을 이루었지만, 적대자가 훈련 데이터를 조작하는 중독(poisoning) 공격에 대한 인증된 견고성은 아직 탐색되지 않았습니다. 이 연구는 기존 이미지 데이터용 인증 방법이 그래프 도메인에서는 실패함을 보여주며, 그래프 데이터의 레이블 및 구조 희소성 문제를 지적하고 새로운 접근 방식을 모색합니다.
items.why_ko: 그래프 신경망의 보안 및 신뢰성 확보에 필수적인 연구로, AI 모델이 악의적인 데이터 주입 공격에 취약할 수 있음을 경고하고, 더욱 견고한 모델을 구축하는 데 필요한 기반 지식을 제공합니다.

items.title: NormMoX: A Normative Mixture of Experts for Explainable Autism Classification from Structural and Functional MRI
items.body: While structural and functional magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI, fMRI) offer profound potential for researching autism spectrum disorder (ASD) and understanding individual neurodivergence, current classifiers lack the explanatory power needed for scientific study, clinical use and personal-level insights. Most models learn from imaging features that also vary with age, sex, scanner site and head motion. They fuse the two modalities without a common reference and explain decisions against arbitrary reference inputs rather than a typical brain. We present NormMoX, a normative mixture of experts that makes the typical brain the shared reference for prediction, fusion and explanation. Normative models trained on large healthy cohorts give the value each brain measure is expected to take for a person's age and sex. NormMoX learns from each person's deviations from these expected values. For each modality, a neural network expert turns the deviations into a score of evidence for ASD. A fusion head, MoX, compares each score with those of typical controls before combining them. It therefore needs no imputation when a modality is missing and shows in which modality each person is atypical. On 1,035 participants of ABIDE I, NormMoX reached an AUROC of $0.728 \pm 0.004$ in repeated cross-validation, above linear, single-modality and deep fusion baselines. NormMoX thus shows not only whether a person is likely to have ASD, but where, and in which modality, their brain departs from typical. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Novelex/NormMox.
items.title_ko: 설명 가능한 자폐증 분류를 위한 규범적 전문가 혼합 모델 NormMoX
items.summary_ko: 구조적 및 기능적 MRI(sMRI, fMRI)는 자폐 스펙트럼 장애(ASD) 연구에 잠재력이 크지만, 현재 분류기는 설명력이 부족합니다. NormMoX는 나이, 성별, 스캐너 위치 등 다양한 요인에 따라 달라지는 영상 특징에서 학습하며, 두 모달리티를 공통된 참조 없이 융합하고 자의적인 설명을 생성하는 기존 모델의 한계를 극복하고자 합니다.
items.why_ko: 의료 진단 AI의 설명 가능성을 높여 임상 및 과학적 활용도를 증진하려는 시도로, 복잡한 뇌 영상 데이터를 해석하는 새로운 방법을 제시합니다.

items.title: FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell
items.body: Attention remains a substantial computational cost in Transformer training, particularly at long context lengths. NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs provide high-throughput low-precision matrix multiplication, but exploiting it in attention requires addressing quantization overhead, causal information leakage through shared scales, and numerical inconsistencies between the forward and backward passes. We present FLAMIA, a family of attention kernels for Blackwell with MXFP8 and mixed NVFP4/FP8 training paths. Our design combines token-block scaling that reuses quantized operands across matrix orientations, targeted safeguards against scale-induced leakage, and consistent forward and backward computations. Fused quantization and architecture-specific kernel optimizations reduce overhead, while document-local scaling and workload-aware scheduling support variable-length documents directly in packed layouts without repacking. Across various causal packed-document workloads, the MXFP8 path accelerates the combined forward and backward attention call, including quantization, by factors of $1.10$--$1.40\times$ on B200 and $1.06$--$1.42\times$ on B300 relative to the fastest evaluated baseline for each workload. We validate training stability and quality preservation on pretraining Llama-style models. These results show how jointly designing quantization, training numerics, and document scheduling translates low-bit hardware throughput into practical attention acceleration.
items.body_ko: Transformer 훈련에서 Attention은 특히 긴 컨텍스트 길이에서 상당한 계산 비용으로 남아 있습니다. NVIDIA Blackwell GPU는 높은 처리량의 낮은 정밀도 행렬 곱셈을 제공하지만, Attention에서 이를 활용하려면 양자화 오버헤드, 공유 스케일을 통한 인과 정보 누출, 그리고 순방향 및 역방향 패스 간의 수치적 불일치를 해결해야 합니다. 우리는 Blackwell용 Attention 커널 제품군인 FLAMIA를 MXFP8 및 혼합 NVFP4/FP8 훈련 경로와 함께 제시합니다. 우리의 설계는 행렬 방향에 걸쳐 양자화된 피연산자를 재사용하는 토큰 블록 스케일링, 스케일 유발 누출에 대한 목표 보호 장치, 그리고 일관된 순방향 및 역방향 계산을 결합합니다. 퓨즈된 양자화 및 아키텍처별 커널 최적화는 오버헤드를 줄이는 반면, 문서 로컬 스케일링 및 워크로드 인식 스케줄링은 재패킹 없이 압축된 레이아웃에서 가변 길이 문서를 직접 지원합니다. 다양한 인과적 압축 문서 워크로드에서 MXFP8 경로는 각 워크로드에 대해 가장 빠른 평가된 기준선과 비교하여 B200에서 $1.10$--$1.40\times$ 그리고 B300에서 $1.06$--$1.42\times$배로 양자화를 포함한 결합된 순방향 및 역방향 Attention 호출을 가속화합니다. 우리는 Llama 스타일 모델의 사전 훈련에서 훈련 안정성과 품질 보존을 검증합니다. 이러한 결과는 양자화, 훈련 수치, 문서 스케줄링을 공동으로 설계하는 것이 낮은 비트 하드웨어 처리량을 실용적인 Attention 가속으로 어떻게 전환하는지 보여줍니다.
items.title_ko: 블랙웰 GPU에서 빠르고 안전한 학습을 위한 Flash MIcroscaling Attention (FLAMIA)
items.summary_ko: 트랜스포머 학습에서 어텐션 메커니즘은 특히 긴 컨텍스트 길이에서 상당한 계산 비용을 차지합니다. NVIDIA Blackwell GPU의 고성능 저정밀도 행렬 곱셈을 활용하기 위해 FLAMIA는 양자화 오버헤드, 공유 스케일을 통한 인과 정보 누출, 전방/후방 패스 간 수치적 불일치를 해결하는 새로운 어텐션 커널을 제안합니다. MXFP8 및 혼합 NVFP4/FP8 학습 경로를 지원하여 Blackwell에서 효율적인 학습을 가능하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: 블랙웰 GPU를 활용하여 트랜스포머 모델의 학습 효율성을 극대화하는 방법을 제시하며, 긴 컨텍스트 LLM 학습 비용 절감 및 속도 향상에 직접적으로 기여하는 핵심 기술입니다.

items.title: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
items.body: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs, and the most accurate SOTA model is a fit, not a law: it absorbs architecture into fitted coefficients, requiring per-LLM fitting. We derive closed-form expressions of the computational and memory-access complexity of LLM inference in terms of architectural hyperparameters, covering MHA and GQA, and compare a family of analytical models of increasing granularity. From these, we obtain the SIMPLE Inference Model to Predict LLMs Energy (SIMPLE), a four-parameter law that separates prefill from decode, and decode into KV-cache cost and next-token computation. Over traces of 13 dense LLMs from six families on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, it attains R2 = 0.969 and 11.97% MAPE, 3.1-3.5x below the SOTA, without per-LLM calibration. The SIMPLE law explains as well as predicts: prefill energy grows quadratically with the hidden dimension, so larger LLMs suffer most from long inputs; and more aggressive GQA KV grouping reduces the per-token energy by up to 3x relative to standard MHA. Increasing the reasoning token budget pushes output length beyond the analytically derived energy minimum, driving super-linear energy growth; although accuracy grows with the budget, energy grows faster, so Intelligence per Joule peaks at an intermediate budget and falls by up to 3.14x across a 4.0x reasoning-budget range. Agentic serving raises energy per request by 13.0x relative to non-agentic ones, driven by the growth of both the prefill and the KV-cache terms with input length; while prefix caching removes most of the prefill cost (-93%), the KV-cache term is unaffected, so even a cached agentic request costs 4.8x more.
items.body_ko: Generative AI는 토큰 단위로 요금이 부과되지만, 모든 토큰이 똑같이 비싼 것은 아닙니다. 각 토큰은 KV-cache에 들어가고 이어지는 토큰의 비용을 증가시키므로, 토큰이 동일하게 보여도 시퀀스를 따라 에너지는 비선형적으로 증가합니다. 토큰 비용을 나타내는 분석 모델은 없으며, 가장 정확한 SOTA 모델은 법칙이 아닌 적합 모델입니다. 즉, 아키텍처를 적합된 계수에 흡수하여 LLM별 적합을 필요로 합니다. 우리는 아키텍처 하이퍼파라미터 측면에서 LLM 추론의 계산 및 메모리 접근 복잡성에 대한 폐쇄형 표현을 도출하며, MHA 및 GQA를 다루고, 점점 더 세분화되는 분석 모델군을 비교합니다. 이를 통해 우리는 SIMPLE Inference Model to Predict LLMs Energy (SIMPLE)를 얻습니다. 이 모델은 프리필(prefill)과 디코드(decode)를 분리하고, 디코드를 KV-cache 비용과 다음 토큰 계산으로 분리하는 4개 매개변수 법칙입니다. NVIDIA H100 GPU에서 6개 계열의 13개 밀집 LLM 추적에 걸쳐, 이 모델은 R2 = 0.969 및 11.97% MAPE를 달성하며, SOTA보다 3.1-3.5배 낮고, LLM별 보정 없이도 가능합니다. SIMPLE 법칙은 예측뿐만 아니라 설명도 잘합니다. 프리필 에너지는 숨겨진 차원(hidden dimension)에 따라 제곱으로 증가하므로, 더 큰 LLM은 긴 입력에서 가장 큰 손실을 입습니다. 또한, 더 공격적인 GQA KV 그룹화는 표준 MHA에 비해 토큰당 에너지를 최대 3배까지 줄입니다. 추론 토큰 예산을 늘리면 분석적으로 도출된 에너지 최솟값을 넘어선 출력 길이가 발생하여 초선형 에너지 증가를 유발합니다. 정확도는 예산과 함께 증가하지만, 에너지는 더 빠르게 증가하므로, Intelligence per Joule은 중간 예산에서 정점에 도달하고 4.0배의 추론 예산 범위에 걸쳐 최대 3.14배 감소합니다. 에이전트 서빙(Agentic serving)은 입력 길이와 함께 프리필 및 KV-cache 항이 모두 증가함에 따라 비 에이전트 요청에 비해 요청당 에너지를 13.0배 증가시킵니다. 접두사 캐싱(prefix caching)은 프리필 비용의 대부분을 제거하지만(-93%), KV-cache 항은 영향을 받지 않으므로 캐시된 에이전트 요청조차도 4.8배 더 많은 비용이 듭니다.
items.title_ko: LLM 추론 에너지 비용에 대한 SIMPLE 법칙 도출
items.summary_ko: 생성형 AI는 토큰당 비용이 청구되지만, 각 토큰은 KV-캐시에 들어가 이후 토큰의 비용을 증가시켜 에너지 소비가 비선형적으로 증가합니다. 이 연구는 LLM 추론의 계산 및 메모리 접근 복잡성에 대한 폐쇄형 표현을 도출하여 토큰당 에너지 비용을 예측하는 'SIMPLE 법칙'을 제시합니다. 이는 아키텍처를 계수에 흡수하여 LLM별 피팅이 필요한 기존 SOTA 모델과 다릅니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 추론의 에너지 효율성과 비용을 이해하고 최적화하는 데 필수적인 이론적 기반을 제공합니다. 이는 실제 LLM 서비스 운영 및 하드웨어 설계에 중요한 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

items.title: From FAIR to AI-FAIR Metadata-First Infrastructure for AI-Enabled Science
items.body: Artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and their capabilities have advanced rapidly over the past few years, leading to widespread interest and adoption in the biological and ecological sciences. However, the data infrastructure and computational resources that provide the foundation for AI workflows in ecology and biodiversity science remain fragmented. Moreover, the flow of value remains largely unidirectional: data move from collectors, through repositories and aggregators into models, and finally to research products or management actions. The derived value, such as corrected taxonomies, annotations, quality flags, and insights, rarely returns to source communities. We propose an extension of the original FAIR principles to address the needs of AI-ready infrastructure: the AI-FAIR metadata criteria, which place AI-enabled science in the context of a bidirectional Question-Data-Model triangle. This framework is designed to facilitate large-scale content-based analysis across diverse collections and ensure that the scientists generating the data benefit from the AI-enabled advances built on their data. Alongside these criteria, we introduce an agentic evaluation workflow that both rates existing datasets on the AI-FAIR and traditional FAIR criteria and provides actionable feedback where critical metadata is missing or incomplete. This modular dataset evaluation tool, paired with a domain-appropriate checklist, translates these principles into a reusable assessment of machine-learning readiness, AI-readiness for specified tasks, traceability, and ethical and CARE-aligned stewardship. Through this approach we aim to create a community-informed system to close the model data loop, so that AI also enriches data to further enable scientific discovery.
items.title_ko: FAIR 원칙에서 AI-FAIR 원칙으로: AI 기반 과학을 위한 메타데이터 중심 인프라
items.summary_ko: AI 기술의 발전으로 생물학 및 생태학 분야에서 AI 활용이 증가하고 있지만, AI 워크플로우를 위한 데이터 인프라와 컴퓨팅 자원은 여전히 파편화되어 있습니다. 이 논문은 FAIR(Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, Reusable) 데이터 원칙을 AI-FAIR 개념으로 확장하여 AI 기반 과학을 위한 메타데이터 중심 인프라의 필요성을 강조합니다. 이는 데이터 가치 흐름이 모델로 향하는 일방향성에서 벗어나 재사용 가능성을 높이는 데 중점을 둡니다.
items.why_ko: AI 연구 및 활용에 필수적인 데이터 관리 및 인프라 구축의 중요성을 강조하며, 더욱 효율적이고 재사용 가능한 AI 기반 과학 생태계를 조성하는 방향을 제시합니다.

items.title: TrafficInstruct: A Multi-Task Network Traffic Dataset and Benchmark for Instruction Tuning
items.body: Instruction tuning for multi-task network traffic analysis requires data with clearly defined sources, supervision targets, and evaluation conditions. We introduce TrafficInstruct, a newly collected dataset comprising raw packet captures and 55,000 structured supervised fine-tuning records across ten tasks: malware traffic detection, botnet detection, malicious DNS-over-HTTPS detection, Web attack detection, advanced persistent threat detection, encrypted VPN detection, Tor behavior detection, encrypted application/service classification, website fingerprinting, and application classification under concept drift. An automated workflow captures traffic from controlled software executions, attack experiments, and application activities. Labels are supported by task-specific collection evidence, including process or socket attribution, activity records, and execution outcomes. Filtering, sanitization, and task-specific transformations produce instructions, traffic observations, and structured answers. We verify sample sources and partition the dataset by complete collection sessions, keeping all samples from the same session within one partition. The benchmark defines allowed inputs, deterministic label mappings, fixed training/validation/test partitions, and task-wise scoring rules. We evaluate majority-class, random-forest, and ET-BERT baselines, an unadapted 27B language model, and independently trained task-specific LoRA adapters on a shared frozen base. Adapters are selected using validation data and evaluated on the corresponding test sets. Task-specific adaptation improves classification performance, supporting instruction tuning across diverse traffic-analysis tasks.
items.title_ko: TrafficInstruct: 명령 튜닝을 위한 다중 작업 네트워크 트래픽 데이터셋 및 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 다중 작업 네트워크 트래픽 분석을 위한 명령 튜닝은 명확한 출처, 감독 대상 및 평가 조건을 갖춘 데이터가 필요합니다. 이 연구는 TrafficInstruct라는 새로운 데이터셋을 소개하며, 이는 원시 패킷 캡처와 10가지 작업(악성 트래픽 감지, 봇넷 감지 등)에 걸쳐 55,000개의 구조화된 감독 미세 조정 기록으로 구성됩니다. 이는 네트워크 보안 및 트래픽 분석을 위한 LLM 개발에 유용합니다.
items.why_ko: 네트워크 트래픽 분석 분야에 특화된 LLM 개발을 위한 고품질 데이터셋과 벤치마크를 제공하여, 실제 산업 문제 해결에 기여할 수 있는 모델 개발을 가속화합니다.

items.title: Steering with Multilingual Lexicons for Sentiment Control in Low-Resource Languages
items.body: Activation steering offers a lightweight mechanism for controlling model behavior, but existing methods depend on sentence-level contrastive data that is unavailable for most of the world's languages. We show that multilingual sentiment lexicons are a viable substitute across three model families: aggregated multilingual lexicons outperform English-derived steering vectors for mid- and low-resource languages, while monolingual lexicons remain stronger for languages a model has specialized in during pre-training. The steering efficacy is mechanistically dictated by both representational density and pre-training priors. Large-magnitude English vectors overwhelm the compact representations of low-resource languages, causing "linguistic collapse." This fragility is mitigated by the norm-dampening of multilingual aggregation. Architectural biases, including bilingual specialization penalty and latent numerical rigidity, also heavily constrain cross-lingual steering responsiveness. Ultimately, our work establishes lexicons as a practical steering signal and offers a comprehensive mechanistic account of cross-lingual steering dynamics.
items.title_ko: 저자원 언어의 감성 제어를 위한 다국어 어휘집 스티어링
items.summary_ko: 활성화 스티어링(Activation Steering)은 모델 행동을 제어하는 경량 메커니즘이지만, 기존 방법은 대부분의 언어에서 사용 불가능한 문장 수준의 대비 데이터에 의존합니다. 이 연구는 다국어 감성 어휘집이 중간 및 저자원 언어에 대한 대안이 될 수 있음을 보여줍니다. 집계된 다국어 어휘집이 영어 기반 스티어링 벡터보다 우수한 성능을 보이며, 모델이 전문화된 언어에서는 단일 언어 어휘집이 더 강력함을 입증합니다.
items.why_ko: 저자원 언어에서 LLM의 감성 제어 및 미세 조정을 가능하게 하여, 글로벌 사용자들을 위한 더욱 포괄적이고 맞춤화된 AI 개발을 지원합니다.

items.title: MultiInpaintCOCO: Fine-Grained Visual Understanding in Multiple Languages
items.body: Previous research shows that vision-language (VL) models struggle to understand fine-grained image details and tend to focus on the overall layout. Moreover, any weakness in English tends to be further amplified in the multilingual setting. To study that, we extend InpaintCOCO, an English dataset focused on fine-grained visual details, to 13 typologically diverse languages across five language families, creating MultiInpaintCOCO - a new multilingual benchmark of 953 minimal-pair examples. We further test several state-of-the-art models in multilingual multimodal retrieval, considering both light VL CLIP-like encoders and large language models. Our results show that performance degrades substantially for lower-resource languages, with the strongest predictor being the data resources available for the languages rather than typological similarity to English. In cross-lingual retrieval, most models exhibit a systematic bias toward English: when given a correct caption in a non-English language and an incorrect one in English, models preferentially select the English caption. This bias varies considerably across architectures. Among the tested models, Gemma 3 shows the strongest English preference while Qwen 3 is the least biased, despite both reaching similar monolingual accuracy across languages. The code is available at https://github.com/ufal/multi-inpaint-coco.
items.title_ko: MultiInpaintCOCO: 다국어 미세 시각 이해 벤치마크
items.summary_ko: 기존 비전-언어(VL) 모델은 미세한 이미지 세부 사항을 이해하는 데 어려움을 겪고 전반적인 레이아웃에 집중하는 경향이 있으며, 이러한 약점은 다국어 환경에서 더욱 증폭됩니다. 이 연구는 InpaintCOCO 데이터셋을 13개 언어로 확장한 MultiInpaintCOCO를 공개합니다. 이는 953개의 최소 쌍 예제로 구성된 새로운 다국어 벤치마크로, 모델의 미세 시각 이해 능력을 다각적으로 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 다국어 환경에서 VL 모델의 미세 시각 이해 능력 향상을 위한 중요한 벤치마크를 제공하며, 더욱 정교하고 다국어를 지원하는 VL 모델 개발에 기여합니다.

items.title: LLMs Depend on Specialist Tools for Out-of-Distribution Generalization in MS/MS Structural Elucidation
items.body: A frontier language model was recently reported to solve 1D NMR structural elucidation without tools. We ask whether this capability transfers to tandem mass spectrometry (MS/MS) in the de novo setting, where the model must propose a structure directly from the spectrum without a candidate list or reference library. To separate reasoning from recall, we build a 100-analyte benchmark from MassSpecGym, split by each analyte's textual footprint into in-distribution (well documented in literature) and out-of-distribution (essentially undocumented) arms. We hold the model, harness, and output format fixed and vary only the LLM's access to domain-specific tools. Without tools, a frontier LLM reaches 52% Top-1 accuracy in-distribution but only 2% out-of-distribution. Only access to de novo structure generators improves out-of-distribution accuracy, raising it to as much as 38% Top-1, and the resulting agent outperforms the standalone de novo models both in and out of distribution. These results suggest that LLMs are not effective at de novo MS/MS structural elucidation on their own, and that further gains depend on the specialist tools available to the agent rather than on the LLM itself.
items.title_ko: LLM은 MS/MS 구조 해독의 OOD 일반화를 위해 전문가 도구에 의존한다
items.summary_ko: 최근 LLM이 도구 없이 1D NMR 구조 해독을 해결했다고 보고되었으나, 이 연구는 이러한 능력이 MS/MS(tandem mass spectrometry)의 de novo 구조 해독에 적용되는지 질문합니다. 모델이 스펙트럼에서 직접 구조를 제안해야 하는 시나리오를 위해 100개 분석물 벤치마크를 구축하고, LLM이 문헌에 잘 문서화되지 않은 OOD(Out-of-Distribution) 샘플에 대해서는 전문가 도구의 도움 없이는 제대로 작동하지 않음을 보여줍니다.
items.why_ko: LLM의 '도구 사용' 능력의 한계를 명확히 하고, 특정 과학 분야에서 LLM의 실제 적용을 위해서는 전문 지식과 도구의 통합이 필수적임을 강조합니다.

items.title: Calibrated Multiaccuracy: Deterministic and Randomized Sample Complexity
items.body:
Calibrated multiaccuracy asks that a predictor be globally calibrated and multiaccurate with respect to a bounded test family $G$; that is, its residuals should be uncorrelated with every test $g(x)\in G$. This weakening of multicalibration suffices for many applications. Its sample complexity was not known to improve on that of full multicalibration, which is $\widetildeΘ\left(\frac{\log|G|}{\varepsilon^2} + \frac{1}{\varepsilon^{3}}\right)$ when $|G|$ is at least a sufficiently large power of $\log(1/\varepsilon)$. We resolve the sample complexity of $\varepsilon$-calibrated multiaccuracy, showing that it scales as $$ \widetildeΘ\left(\frac{\log|G|}{\varepsilon^2} + \frac{1}{\varepsilon^{5/2}}\right), $$ separating it from the complexity of multicalibration. The upper bound is obtained by an algorithm that outputs a randomized predictor.
For deterministic predictors, we establish the tight rate $$
\widetildeΘ\left(
\frac{\log|G|}{\varepsilon^2}
+
\frac{(\log|G|)^{1/3}}{\varepsilon^{8/3}}
\right) $$ whenever $\log|G|=Ω(\log(1/\varepsilon))$. When $\log|G|\le\varepsilon^{-1+κ}$ for any fixed $κ\in(0,1)$, this rate is polynomially larger than the rate for randomized predictors. Thus, unlike for multicalibration, calibrated multiaccuracy exhibits a genuine sample-complexity separation between deterministic and randomized predictors. The matching upper and lower bounds show that the unusual cube-root dependence on $\log|G|$ is intrinsic. At $\log|G|\asymp\varepsilon^{-1}$, the minimax rates for randomized and deterministic calibrated multiaccuracy both coincide with the minimax rate for multicalibration.
items.title_ko: 캘리브레이션된 다중 정확도: 결정론적 및 무작위 샘플 복잡도
items.summary_ko: 캘리브레이션된 다중 정확도(Calibrated Multiaccuracy)는 예측기가 전역적으로 보정되고 제한된 테스트 패밀리 $G$에 대해 다중 정확도를 가져야 함을 요구합니다. 이는 예측기의 잔차가 모든 테스트 $g(x)\in G$와 상관관계가 없어야 함을 의미합니다. 이 연구는 이 완화된 형태의 다중 정확도가 여러 애플리케이션에 충분하며, 샘플 복잡도가 전체 다중 정확도보다 개선될 수 있음을 보였습니다.
items.why_ko: AI 모델의 공정성 및 신뢰성 평가에 중요한 이론적 기반을 제공하며, 특히 모델의 예측이 다양한 하위 그룹에서 공정하게 이루어지는지 보장하는 방법을 모색합니다.

items.title: EventGPT: Next-Event Pretraining on Banking Customer Histories
items.body: A model pretrained to predict a customer's next event can estimate the probability of future events without training on their labels and provide a reusable representation for supervised downstream banking tasks. We pretrain EventGPT, a hierarchical causal transformer, by next-token maximum likelihood estimation on the public Multimodal Banking Dataset (MBD-mini: 100,224 clients, 38.8 million transactions and 66.3 million geolocation pings). Keeping one state per event, EventGPT trains in about two hours on one L4 GPU at windows up to 8,192 tokens. From its next-event distribution, with no labels, EventGPT scores five targets of the form "the client makes a transaction of a given kind for the first time next month" at ROC-AUC 0.79 to 0.92. Gradient boosting on 114 engineered features needs 10,000 to 300,000 labeled client-months to match it on four targets and stays below it on the fifth. For product prediction, frozen EventGPT embeddings score below the engineered features (mean ROC-AUC 0.787 against 0.808 over five test folds), and a rank-averaged ensemble of EventGPT, profile fields and token counts with the engineered features adds 0.014 to 0.017, of which 0.007 to 0.016 is EventGPT's own. The code and pretrained weights are released.
items.title_ko: EventGPT: 은행 고객 이력에 대한 차기 이벤트 사전 학습 모델
items.summary_ko: 고객의 다음 이벤트를 예측하도록 사전 학습된 모델은 미래 이벤트의 확률을 추정하고 감독 학습을 위한 재사용 가능한 표현을 제공할 수 있습니다. 이 연구는 공개 Multimodal Banking Dataset(MBD-mini)을 사용하여 EventGPT라는 계층적 인과 트랜스포머를 사전 학습했습니다. EventGPT는 이벤트당 하나의 상태를 유지하여 대규모 금융 데이터를 효율적으로 학습하고 처리합니다.
items.why_ko: 금융 분야에서 고객 행동 예측 및 맞춤형 서비스 제공을 위한 강력한 AI 모델을 제시하며, 대규모 시퀀스 데이터를 활용한 사전 학습 모델의 잠재력을 보여줍니다.

items.title: An Axiomatic Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Open Multi-Agent Systems
items.body: Open multi-agent systems, where only a subset of agents are controllable, are central to real-world domains such as smart grids, yet lack a principled foundation for reinforcement learning algorithm design. We study this setting through n-agent ad hoc teamwork (NAHT), a recent framework for learning in open multi-agent environments. We propose an axiomatic framework that derives value function learning from the Shapley axioms (Efficiency, Symmetry and Linearity), treating them as structural constraints rather than heuristic design choices. This formulation builds on a novel NAHT decomposition, which characterises the fundamental difference between open and fully controllable multi-agent systems, and establishes a cooperative game-theoretic foundation for learning. We further show that enforcing these axioms on learning individual value functions recovers the Shapley value for Dec-POMDPs, providing a principled bridge between reinforcement learning and classical cooperative game theory. Building on this framework, we introduce Shapley Machines and Banzhaf Machines, two generic algorithmic templates that can be instantiated with standard reinforcement learning methods. When applied to strong base algorithms such as IPPO and POAM, our methods consistently improve learning efficiency and generalisation to unseen agent types and conventions across NAHT benchmark tasks. The code of experiments is published on https://github.com/hsvgbkhgbv/axiomatic-rl-naht.
items.title_ko: 개방형 다중 에이전트 시스템 강화를 위한 공리적 프레임워크
items.summary_ko: 제어 가능한 에이전트만 존재하는 개방형 다중 에이전트 시스템은 스마트 그리드와 같은 실제 분야에서 중요하지만, 강화 학습 알고리즘 설계를 위한 원칙적인 기반이 부족합니다. 이 연구는 Shapley 공리(효율성, 대칭성, 선형성)에서 가치 함수 학습을 도출하는 공리적 프레임워크를 제안하여 개방형 다중 에이전트 환경에서 학습하는 새로운 방법론을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 다중 에이전트 강화 학습의 이론적 기초를 강화하고, 복잡한 실제 환경에서 에이전트들의 협력 및 학습을 보다 효과적으로 설계하는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: SQLoom: Set-Contrastive Learning of Syntactic, Semantic, and Logical Dependencies for Text-to-SQL
items.body: Text-to-SQL translates natural language questions into SQL queries, enabling database access without writing SQL. Fine-tuning open-weight large language models (LLMs) is cost-effective, but existing methods treat SQL as ordinary text and optimize token-level likelihood without explicitly modeling its syntactic, semantic, and logical requirements. Thus, a single incorrect alias or comparison operator can invalidate a query while contributing little to training loss. We propose SQLoom, a constraint-aware fine-tuning framework with supervision at three levels: syntactic validity under SQL grammar and database schema, semantic alignment between query decisions and the question, and logical consistency across dependent clause decisions. SQLoom extends supervised fine-tuning with a unified set-contrastive objective favoring sets of correct outputs over minimally different incorrect ones at each level. LLM agents propose this supervision, which a SQL parser and execution on counterexample databases verify. We also release Spider-Refined, a training dataset correcting 378 flawed Spider annotations and enriching database schemas. Experiments on Spider, BIRD, and three perturbed Spider variants show that SQLoom improves execution accuracy for Qwen3-1.7B from 62.9% zero-shot to 88.7% on Spider development, reaching 89.2% on Spider test and 73.4% on BIRD development. It outperforms fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and agent-based baselines with up to 70 billion parameters. On question perturbations, SQLoom loses at most 0.6 accuracy points versus up to 12.1 for agent-based methods. It generates SQL in a single pass at 0.42s per query, 23$\times$ faster than a GPT-4-based agent method. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of set-contrastive supervision over token-level training.
items.title_ko: SQLoom: Text-to-SQL을 위한 구문, 의미, 논리적 의존성 집합 대비 학습
items.summary_ko: Text-to-SQL은 자연어 질문을 SQL 쿼리로 변환하는 기술로, LLM 미세 조정이 효과적이지만 기존 방법은 SQL을 일반 텍스트로 취급하여 구문, 의미, 논리적 요구사항을 명시적으로 모델링하지 못합니다. SQLoom은 SQL의 특성을 고려한 제약 조건 기반 집합 대비 학습(set-contrastive learning) 프레임워크를 제안하여, 사소한 오류로 쿼리가 무효화되는 문제를 해결하고 더 정확한 SQL 생성을 목표로 합니다.
items.why_ko: Text-to-SQL 모델의 정확성과 견고성을 향상시키는 실용적인 방법을 제시하며, 개발자가 LLM을 사용하여 데이터베이스와 자연어로 상호작용하는 애플리케이션을 더 효과적으로 구축할 수 있도록 돕습니다.

items.title: Inferring Transferable Rewards via Active Inverse Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) aims to recover expert rewards that transfer across environments with differing dynamics. Prior work has shown that such transfer is possible when gathering expert demonstrations across sufficiently different dynamics. In practice, however, expert demonstrations are costly, making it critical to select the right dynamics to reduce the quantity of expert data required for learning transferable rewards. We propose a two-phase approach: we first cycle through the available dynamics to obtain a reliable reward estimate, then actively select dynamics to reduce our uncertainty about the expert reward. Crucially, this yields novel sample complexity guarantees on transfer that hold for any dynamics, with a rate independent of the number of available dynamics. Empirically, our method significantly reduces the number of expert demonstrations needed to learn a transferable reward.
items.title_ko: 능동적 역 강화 학습을 통한 이전 가능한 보상 추론
items.summary_ko: 역 강화 학습(IRL)은 동역학이 다른 환경 간에 이전 가능한 전문가 보상을 복구하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 이전 연구에서는 충분히 다른 동역학 전반에 걸쳐 전문가 데모를 수집할 때 이러한 이전이 가능함을 보여주었습니다. 이 연구는 두 단계 접근 방식을 제안합니다: 먼저 충분히 다른 동역학을 순환하며 전문가 데모를 수집하고, 이를 통해 이전 가능한 보상을 학습합니다.
items.why_ko: 로봇 공학 및 자율 시스템에서 효율적인 학습을 위한 이전 가능한 보상 함수를 추론하는 방법을 개선하며, 전문가 데이터 수집 비용을 줄이는 데 기여합니다.

items.title: ENGINE: Endogenous Variational MultiScale Optimization for Zeroth-Order LLM Fine-Tuning
items.body: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient large language model (LLM) fine-tuning, and recent methods incorporate curvature-aware strategies. However, in the high-dimensional parameter space of LLMs, these methods inherently suffer from exploding gradient variance and prohibitive costs. Conversely, confining updates to a low-dimensional subspace reduces variance but discards critical high-dimensional information, degrading performance. This creates a fundamental dilemma: full-space optimization is informative but has high variance, while subspace optimization has low variance but loses information. To break this trade-off, we propose ENGINE (Endogenous Variational MultiScale). Inspired by computational mechanics, we adapt static Variational MultiScale (VMS) theory to dynamic optimization, treating low- and high-dimensional spaces as resolved coarse and unresolved fine scales. Through a multigrid-style V-cycle, ENGINE alternates between spaces, dynamically probing fine-grained information in the high-dimensional space and injecting it to correct the efficient low-dimensional sampling process. Under appropriate assumptions, statistical analysis characterizes variance reduction and correction of curvature-induced bias, and convergence analysis establishes a stationarity bound for the corrected coarse updates. Evaluations on standard LLM benchmarks show that ENGINE achieves higher accuracy and faster convergence than existing ZO methods, achieving up to a $2.61\times$ speed-up in forward passes with zero additional peak memory overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/AI4Science-WestlakeU/ENGINE.
items.title_ko: ENGINE: 제로차 LLM 미세 조정을 위한 내생적 변이형 다중 스케일 최적화
items.summary_ko: 제로차(Zeroth-order, ZO) 최적화는 메모리 효율적인 LLM 미세 조정을 가능하게 하지만, 고차원 파라미터 공간에서는 기울기 분산 폭발과 높은 비용 문제가 있습니다. ENGINE은 저차원 부분 공간에 업데이트를 제한하면서도 중요한 고차원 정보를 보존하는 내생적 변이형 다중 스케일 최적화를 제안하여, 분산 감소와 성능 저하 사이의 딜레마를 해결합니다.
items.why_ko: LLM 미세 조정의 메모리 효율성을 높이면서도 성능을 유지하는 고급 최적화 기법을 제시하여, 리소스 제약이 있는 환경에서도 LLM을 효과적으로 활용할 수 있게 합니다.

items.title: Top-$k$ Retrieval Leaves Memory Value Undetermined
items.body: A memory-augmented agent must decide which memories to keep, merge and retrieve, and its only evidence of their value is its retrieval log: the memories it retrieved in each episode and whether it succeeded. Existing methods assign every memory a value from this log, even when the log cannot separate one memory's contribution from another's. We treat the log as an experiment that nobody designed and ask which memory values it determines. Two counts answer this before any outcome is observed: how often each memory was retrieved, and how often each pair was retrieved together. From these counts, we prove that top-$k$ retrieval leaves every memory value undetermined, however many episodes are logged, and that a question with its own memories, asked once, determines at most one of their values. On fourteen standard memory benchmarks, no memory value is determined in any of 55 configurations. Both causes are choices about retrieval. We introduce LEDGER, which estimates each determined Shapley value in closed form with a confidence interval and reports every other value as undetermined. It merges memories with identical histories without losing a determined value, and it retrieves so that the next log determines more. On pooled HotpotQA, LEDGER raises the fraction of memories determined from 0.001 to 0.797, at a cost of 2.6 accuracy points on HotpotQA and with a gain of 2.7 on LoCoMo.
items.title_ko: Top-$k$ 검색이 메모리 가치를 미결정 상태로 남기는 문제
items.summary_ko: 메모리 증강 에이전트는 어떤 메모리를 유지, 병합 및 검색할지 결정해야 하지만, 메모리 가치에 대한 유일한 증거는 검색 로그뿐입니다. 기존 방법은 로그에서 모든 메모리에 값을 할당하지만, 이 연구는 로그가 개별 메모리의 기여를 분리할 수 없는 경우 메모리 가치가 미결정 상태로 남을 수 있음을 지적합니다. 발생 횟수와 성공 횟수가 메모리 가치를 결정하지 못하는 상황을 분석합니다.
items.why_ko: 기억 기반 AI 시스템의 효율성과 학습 메커니즘을 더 깊이 이해하는 데 도움을 주며, 메모리 관리 및 검색 전략 설계에 대한 새로운 시사점을 제공합니다.

items.title: Specificity Bias and the Wikipedia Paradox: An xAI Analysis of AI Text Detectors under Domain Shift
items.body: The widespread adoption of Large Language Models (LLMs) demands reliable detection of human-authored versus synthetic text. However, current Transformer-based detectors often experience severe performance degradation during domain shifts and operate as opaque classifiers. This paper investigates the robustness and interpretability of fine-tuned Transformer models (DistilBERT, RoBERTa) by evaluating them against a custom out-of-distribution (OOD) dataset of hyper-local news synthesized via open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma). To analyze model decision boundaries, we apply a tripartite Explainable AI (xAI) framework using SHAP. Our analysis reveals three key phenomena: First, detectors often rely on a "Call-to-Action" syndrome inherent to instruction-tuned LLMs rather than generic machine text. Second, we observe a "Specificity Bias," where LLMs successfully bypass detection by hallucinating specific named entities and mimicking conversational imperfection. Finally, we illustrate the "Wikipedia Paradox," wherein formal, objective human writing is frequently misclassified as AI due to its low statistical burstiness. These findings demonstrate that purely statistical detection paradigms face systematic limitations in highly structured human domains, emphasizing the critical need for semantically-aware, interpretable detection architectures.
items.title_ko: 특정성 편향 및 위키피디아 역설: 도메인 전환 시 AI 텍스트 감지기 xAI 분석
items.summary_ko: LLM의 확산으로 인간 작성 텍스트와 합성 텍스트를 안정적으로 감지하는 것이 중요하지만, 현재 트랜스포머 기반 감지기는 도메인 전환 시 성능이 크게 저하됩니다. 이 논문은 미세 조정된 트랜스포머 모델(DistilBERT, RoBERTa)의 견고성과 해석 가능성을 조사하며, OOD(Out-of-Distribution) 데이터셋에 대한 평가를 통해 '특정성 편향'과 '위키피디아 역설'을 분석하고 AI 텍스트 감지기의 신뢰성 문제를 탐구합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 생성 텍스트 감지기의 신뢰성 문제와 한계를 명확히 보여주며, 실제 환경에서 AI 텍스트 감지 기술을 적용할 때 발생할 수 있는 잠재적 위험을 이해하는 데 중요합니다.

items.title: Strictly proper scoring rules for node selection tasks on graphs
items.body: In node selection tasks, the goal is to identify a single unknown target node in a graph. We consider probabilistic supervised node selection, where the estimator outputs a probability distribution over the nodes of the graph and the ground-truth node is available for evaluation. Classical evaluation metrics for such tasks are either statistically ill-conceived or blind to the graph structure. To fill this gap, we introduce two strictly proper scoring rules that are explicitly graph-aware: the Resistance score, which is parameter-free, and the Diffusion score, which operates at an adjustable coarse-graining resolution. We show that the Diffusion score interpolates between the multi-category Brier score and a cluster-level weighted Brier score. The Resistance score generalises two classical scoring rules: the multi-category Brier score and the Ranked probability score. Applied to rooted trees, it also serves as the strictly proper version of the improper Hierarchical error distance used in hierarchical classification. In the same setting, we furthermore establish strict propriety of the Hierarchical cross-entropy family, a recently introduced separate class of hierarchy-aware scoring rules. Experiments on epidemic source detection and on ImageNet classification confirm that the proposed scores detect meaningful differences in estimation quality that classical metrics miss.
items.title_ko: 그래프의 노드 선택 작업을 위한 엄격하게 적절한 점수 규칙
items.summary_ko: 노드 선택 작업은 그래프에서 단일 알려지지 않은 대상 노드를 식별하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 이 연구는 확률적 감독 노드 선택(확률 분포 출력, 정답 노드 사용)을 고려하며, 이러한 작업에 대한 고전적인 평가 지표가 통계적으로 부적절하거나 그래프 구조를 고려하지 못하는 문제를 해결합니다. 두 가지 엄격하게 적절한 그래프 인식 점수 규칙을 소개합니다.
items.why_ko: 그래프 데이터셋에서 머신러닝 모델의 성능을 평가하는 데 더 정확하고 통계적으로 건전한 방법을 제공하여, 그래프 기반 AI 연구의 발전에 기여합니다.

items.title: A Human-Verified AI Workflow for Annotating Environmental Sound Data
items.body: Large-scale annotation of environmental sound recordings presents significant challenges under time and resource constraints, particularly when sound categories are imbalanced and only part of a dataset has been labeled. This paper describes the development and evaluation of a human-AI workflow used during annotation of the Kenya Forest Sounds Dataset (KFSD), using a project-stage working collection of 7,531 audio recordings across 21 categories. We investigated zero-shot classification, a feature-based ensemble, and a fine-tuned Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST). The fine-tuned AST achieved 89.36% accuracy, 85.98% precision, 89.24% recall, and 87.58% F1 on held-out test data for binary classification of Person talking. Because this result remained below the predefined 95% threshold for autonomous annotation, model predictions were used as suggestions and subjected to human verification. Of the 5,026 initially unlabeled recordings, 2,337 were routed to a speech-verification queue and 2,689 remained for ordinary manual annotation. The verifier reviewed all 2,337 machine-labeled files and detected zero false positives, yielding 100% verification accuracy. The observed average verification time was approximately 4.2 seconds per file. At an average rate of 35 seconds per file for manual annotation, the hybrid workflow reduced work on the remaining queue from approximately 48.9 to 28.9 person-hours, saving about 20.0 hours (41%). The study documents the model-selection process, provenance-aware file organization, verification procedure, observed errors, practical limitations, and opportunities for extending AI assistance beyond one category.
items.title_ko: 인간 검증 AI 워크플로우를 통한 환경 음향 데이터 주석
items.summary_ko: 환경 음향 데이터의 대규모 주석은 시간 및 자원 제약으로 인해 큰 어려움을 겪습니다. 이 논문은 케냐 숲 소리 데이터셋(KFSD) 주석 과정에서 사용된 인간-AI 워크플로우를 설명합니다. 7,531개 오디오 녹음 및 21개 카테고리로 구성된 데이터셋에 대해 제로샷 분류, 특징 기반 분류, 능동 학습을 활용하여 효율적인 주석을 수행하는 방법을 개발하고 평가합니다.
items.why_ko: 대규모 데이터셋 구축 및 관리에 어려움을 겪는 개발자에게 AI와 인간의 협업을 통해 주석 작업을 효율화하는 실용적인 방법을 제시하며, 특히 음향 데이터 분야에 적용 가능합니다.

items.title: DeepWaveRL: Self-Supervised Full Waveform Inversion via Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Full Waveform Inversion (FWI) is a fundamental inverse problem in geophysics to estimate subsurface properties, such as velocity, from seismic measurements. Recently, self-supervised learning methods remove the need for ground-truth velocity maps during training by leveraging a forward operator to simulate seismic data from predictions and backpropagate the gradients of reconstruction loss through it. In this work, we consider a more challenging setting without accessing such gradients. To this end, we incorporate reinforcement learning into self-supervised FWI and propose a framework named DeepWaveRL. Specifically, we reformulate FWI as a policy learning problem, where the policy network predicts velocity maps as actions, and a forward operator is used solely for simulation. A global scalar reward is computed based on data misfit for each prediction and used to weight policy gradients. Thus, learning proceeds without accessing the gradients from the forward operator. Given the indirect and coarse supervision signals, we further identify key strategies to stabilize learning and mitigate the spatial credit assignment bottleneck. Experimental results show that, despite relying entirely on a single scalar reward, DeepWaveRL achieves competitive performance compared to supervised and self-supervised baselines. These findings suggest that our framework offers a flexible and complementary learning paradigm for the FWI research community.
items.title_ko: DeepWaveRL: 강화 학습을 통한 자기 지도 전체 파형 역변환
items.summary_ko: 전체 파형 역변환(FWI)은 지진 측정으로부터 지하 특성을 추정하는 지구 물리학의 근본적인 문제이지만, 훈련 중 실제 속도 맵 접근이 어렵습니다. 이 연구는 이러한 기울기 접근 없이 더 도전적인 설정을 고려합니다. DeepWaveRL은 강화 학습을 통해 자기 지도 방식으로 FWI를 수행하여, 실제 속도 맵 없이도 지하 구조를 정확하게 추정할 수 있는 가능성을 제시합니다.
items.why_ko: 지하 탐사와 같은 복잡하고 데이터 확보가 어려운 분야에서 자기 지도 학습과 강화 학습을 결합하여 문제를 해결하는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시합니다.

items.title: The Cost of Mismatch: Noise Amplification in Zeroth-Order Reinforcement Learning
items.body: Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization has emerged as a promising approach for memory-efficient large language model (LLM) post-training, yet its reliable application to reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) remains largely unexplored. Motivated by the distinct data regimes of on-policy RL and fixed-data optimization, we develop a generic variance-theoretic framework to investigate what limits the reliability of ZO gradient estimation. Our analysis reveals that estimation reliability is structurally determined by whether the two finite-difference evaluations are performed on matched data. On-policy reinforcement learning (RL) under the mismatched-data regime produces a $1/μ^2$ oracle-noise amplification that sets an irreducible noise floor as the perturbation scale $μ$ decreases, whereas Boltzmann Targeted SFT (BOLT) under the matched-data regime eliminates this amplification via noise cancellation. We further derive convergence guarantees with explicit constants that cleanly separate the two regimes. These results naturally lead to ZO-BOLT, which applies ZO optimization to BOLT's RLVR-aligned weighted-SFT objective. Controlled perturbation-scale sweeps and matched-versus-mismatched end-to-end comparisons validate the predicted effect of data matching. Experiments across three model variants and two mathematical reasoning benchmarks further show that ZO-BOLT consistently improves over the pretrained baseline while retaining a near-inference memory footprint. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/lianmin-chen/the_cost_of_mismatch.
items.title_ko: 불일치 비용: 제로차 강화 학습에서의 노이즈 증폭
items.summary_ko: 제로차(ZO) 최적화는 메모리 효율적인 LLM 후처리(post-training)에 유망하지만, 검증 가능한 보상을 가진 강화 학습(RLVR)에 대한 신뢰할 수 있는 적용은 탐구되지 않았습니다. 이 연구는 온-정책 RL과 고정 데이터 최적화의 다른 데이터 체제에서 ZO 기울기 추정의 신뢰성을 제한하는 요인을 조사하는 일반적인 분산-이론 프레임워크를 개발합니다. 분석 결과, 추정 신뢰성이 '불일치 비용'에 의해 좌우됨을 밝힙니다.
items.why_ko: 제로차 최적화 기반 강화 학습의 안정성과 신뢰성을 이해하는 데 필수적인 통찰을 제공하며, 특히 LLM의 후처리 및 RL 활용에 대한 실용적 한계를 제시합니다.

items.title: Rethinking Fairness Metrics for Multi-Class and Multi-Group Assessment: Not Everything is Binary
items.body: Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning in general, is becoming pervasive across all domains and disciplines. By means of this data-driven approach, algorithms can learns complex task just by learning from samples. However, if the data-set is biased, they might lead to the development of unfair computer systems, that is, characterised by a prejudice towards specific individuals or groups, which might get an unmotivated output from the system. This circumstance lead to the development of multiple metrics designed to quantify the level of unfairness of an algorithm. However, a generalised assumption in the literature is that the sensitive features and the output labels are binary. When the data is not binary, it is forcefully binarized using a one-versus-the-rest simplification. In this work, we discuss the limitations of existing metrics and propose novel, mathematically sound, and generalized multi-group and multi-class formulations of the metrics. Ultimately, our results highlight the empirical assessment distortion caused by binarization strategies, which reveals the limitations of binary fairness metrics in the multi class setting.
items.title_ko: 다중 클래스 및 다중 그룹 평가를 위한 공정성 지표 재고: 모든 것이 이진적이지는 않다
items.summary_ko: AI와 머신러닝이 모든 분야에 확산되면서 데이터 편향으로 인해 불공정한 시스템이 개발될 수 있습니다. 기존 공정성 지표는 주로 이진 분류에 초점을 맞추고 있어 다중 클래스 및 다중 그룹 시나리오에 적합하지 않습니다. 이 연구는 이러한 한계를 지적하고, 보다 포괄적인 다중 클래스 및 다중 그룹 평가를 위한 새로운 공정성 지표의 필요성을 역설합니다.
items.why_ko: AI 공정성 연구의 중요한 방향 전환을 제시하며, 실제 복잡한 사회 문제를 해결하는 AI 시스템이 다양한 집단에 대해 공정하게 작동하도록 평가하고 설계하는 데 필수적인 지식을 제공합니다.

items.title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
items.body: Reviso is an agentic video captioning framework that learns to prioritize key visual evidence through hierarchical planning and active perception, improving caption quality and downstream video understanding.
items.title_ko: Reviso: 비디오 캡셔닝에서 모든 시각적 증거가 동일한 주의를 받을 필요는 없다
items.summary_ko: Reviso는 계층적 계획과 능동적 인식을 통해 주요 시각적 증거의 우선순위를 정하는 agentic 비디오 캡셔닝 프레임워크입니다. 이 방법을 통해 캡션 품질과 하위 비디오 이해도를 향상시킬 수 있습니다. 이는 단순히 모든 프레임에 동일한 가중치를 부여하는 것이 아니라, 핵심 정보를 선별적으로 처리함으로써 더 효율적이고 정확한 비디오 요약을 가능하게 합니다.
items.why_ko: 비디오 캡셔닝 및 이해 모델의 효율성과 정확도를 높이는 새로운 접근 방식을 제시하며, 대규모 비디오 콘텐츠 분석 및 요약 기술 발전에 기여합니다.

items.title: Qwen 3.8 27B on my laptop can interpret model weights, too
items.body:
Yesterday's hot paper was Sparks of Weight-Space Programming: LLMs can natively read & write neural network weights by Rikiya Takehi, Jayden Teoh, Alex Zhang, and Omar Khattab. The paper (OK, the authors classify is as a "blog post", but it's paper-shaped) found that frontier models, in particular GPT-6 Astra, can both interpret and modify the raw weights of a machine learning model - literally a text description of the model containing a bunch of floating point numbers. I've been playing with one of the examples from the paper and I'm delighted to share that Qwen 3.8 27B running on my laptop can do this as well!

Weight-Space Programming

Here's the highlight from their abstract, describing impressive capabilities for GPT-6 Astra and coining the term Weight-Space Programming for when LLMs analyze and modify model weights:

Just by looking at the raw weights, GPT-6 Astra can tell what a network was trained to do. And without any environment feedback, it has no trouble writing, from scratch, small game-playing networks that outplay networks trained with PPO for 100 million steps.

Likewise, asked to make Qwen3.5-0.8B better at math without gradients, Astra identifies an issue in its weights causing reasoning loops that Qwen’s own model card warns about, and fixes this by natively editing 0.016% of the weights. With the same sampling settings, this weight correction raises MATH-500 from 7.9% to 48.1% and generalizes out of the box to instruction following, raising IFEval by 3x.

All of this is possible without allowing Astra to write training loops. It uses its reasoning to figure out what each part of a neural network computes, or should compute, and changes the weights accordingly. We call this Weight-Space Programming.

The paper combines two topics that I think deserve to be treated separately. The first is what models can do with raw weights without running tools or executing code. The second explores how well models, once armed with code, can run operations to update and improve other models.

spaCy author Matthew Honnibal called the paper misleading for conflating the two, and Sean Goedecke deconstructed the Qwen3.5-0.8B update example as taking the same steps that a human ML researcher would use.

I'm going to focus on the no-tools question, which I think is the more interesting of the two.

The paper presents the first question as Can LLMs understand model behaviors from weights? They trained four neural networks to play simplified 10x10 grid versions of four classic computer games - Breakout, Pong, Pac-Man, and Freeway (I had to look that one up, it's an Atari 2600 game from 1981). Then they fed those weights (as floating point numbers) to an LLM along with the following question:

The weights below belong to one policy network that was trained with reinforcement learning to play a game on this grid. Which game was it trained on? Work from the weights. You have no tools: no code execution, no calculator, nothing to run. This is a single response.

The GitHub repository that accompanies the paper is RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs. The exp1_which_game folder contains the prompts they used, with weights for the four games:

breakout/prompt.txt

freeway/prompt.txt

pacman/prompt.txt

pong/prompt.txt

I checked and, aside from the weights, each prompt is identical to the others.

Trying it out with Qwen 3.8 27B and other models

The prompts on GitHub are self-contained. My LLM tool has a -f/--fragment option which can be passed the URL to a text file to use as a prompt, which means I can run any of the above like this:

llm -f https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RikiyaT/lm_understand-logs/refs/heads/main/exp1_which_game/runs/breakout/prompt.txt \
-m openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3.1-pro

This example requires the llm-openrouter plugin installed, and runs the Breakout prompt against Kimi K3.1 Pro via OpenRouter. Here's what I got back from Kimi K3.1 Pro, which successfully guessed Breakout after 9m 41s and 19,493 reasoning tokens.
